title: End-to-end Particle Reconstruction with Transformers in High-Granularity Calorimeters
summary: The High-Luminosity upgrade of the Large Hadron Collider (HL-LHC) will drastically increase the number of simultaneously interacting particles, posing a severe challenge to current particle reconstruction methods. While next-generation highly granular calorimeters offer unprecedented 3D measurement capabilities, reconstructing particles from heavily overlapping energy showers remains computationally difficult. This study investigates how raw detector hits can be accurately reconstructed using end-to-end transformer based methods on a simulated calorimeter dataset. We evaluate and compare three distinct machine learning frameworks, focusing on two generative architectures: diffusion and flow matching as well as query-based set prediction. Our results demonstrate that these advanced methods provide highly effective and scalable alternatives for resolving complex overlapping particle showers in conditions encountered in future calorimeters.

AI.tldr: 本研究面向HL-LHC高颗粒度量能器中严重重叠簇射的粒子重建难题，系统比较了扩散模型、流匹配两类生成式架构与查询式集合预测框架在模拟量能器数据上的端到端Transformer重建表现，结果表明这些方法可为未来高亮度条件下的重叠簇射解析提供高效、可扩展的替代方案。
AI.motivation: HL-LHC升级将大幅提高同时相互作用的粒子数，对现有粒子重建方法构成严峻挑战；下一代高颗粒度量能器虽具备前所未有的三维测量能力，但从高度重叠的能量簇射中重建粒子在计算上仍十分困难，亟需可扩展的端到端重建方案。
AI.method: 基于模拟量能器数据集，研究原始探测器命中（raw hits）的端到端Transformer重建方法；评估并比较三种机器学习框架，重点包括两种生成式架构——扩散模型（diffusion）与流匹配（flow matching），以及基于查询的集合预测（query-based set prediction）。
AI.result: 实验表明，上述先进方法在未来量能器所面临的重叠条件下，能够有效且可扩展地解析复杂的重叠粒子簇射，为原始命中重建提供了高性能替代方案。
AI.conclusion: 端到端Transformer结合扩散/流匹配生成式建模与查询式集合预测，可有效应对HL-LHC高堆积条件下的簇射重叠重建问题，具备良好的可扩展性，适合作为未来高颗粒度量能器重建算法的候选方向。

title: Converting a superseded Raith electron beam pattern generator into an unattended Critical Dimension SEM
summary: Design-based metrology of academic electron beam lithography (EBL) is bottlenecked by low-throughput imaging. For integrated photonics, where nanometre-scale structural variation can significantly limit device performance, scanning electron microscopy (SEM) is the standard tool for critical dimension (CD) metrology, revealing the structure of devices that is not available from optical measurements. Manual SEM imaging on a wafer-scale is time-intensive, can feature operator-dependent distortions, and yields too few data to reliably close the nanofabrication calibration loop. The following details a methodology that utilises existing hardware in an academic cleanroom: a GDSII-to-SEM software workflow that converts a facility's superseded pattern generator into a CD-SEM for unattended image acquisition and efficient CD and line edge roughness (LER) extraction. This is shown for a Raith eLine Plus, and is expected to be applicable to other pattern generators running Raith's NanoSuite. Presented are results demonstrating its three use cases within a facility: accelerated calibration of two photoresists' process windows; chip-scale metrology of integrated photonic devices to track CD variation; and mass dataset acquisition for convolutional neural network training to predict process distortion. This methodology enables foundry-style, metrology-driven process calibration in academic cleanrooms, generalisable beyond photonics to any EBL nanofabrication that requires nanometre-scale CD control.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于GDSII到SEM的软件工作流，将学术洁净室中被淘汰的图形发生器改造为CD-SEM，实现无人值守的纳米级关键尺寸（CD）与线边缘粗糙度（LER）量测，并在光刻胶工艺窗口标定、光子器件芯片级CD追踪及CNN训练数据采集三类场景中验证其有效性。
AI.motivation: 学术电子束光刻（EBL）的基于设计量测受限于成像吞吐量低；集成光子学中纳米级结构偏差显著影响器件性能，而SEM是CD量测的标准工具，但晶圆级人工SEM成像耗时长、存在操作者相关畸变、数据量不足以闭合纳米加工校准环路。因此需要一种可无人化、高通量的CD-SEM方案以在学术洁净室中实现foundry式的量测驱动工艺校准。
AI.method: 利用学术洁净室现有硬件，开发GDSII-to-SEM软件工作流，将设施内已被取代的图形发生器转换为CD-SEM，实现无人值守图像采集与高效CD及LER提取；在Raith eLine Plus上演示，并预计可推广至其他运行Raith NanoSuite的图形发生器。
AI.result: 展示了三类用例：加速两种光刻胶工艺窗口的标定；对集成光子器件进行芯片级量测以追踪CD变化；批量数据集采集用于训练卷积神经网络以预测工艺畸变。
AI.conclusion: 该方法使学术洁净室能够实现foundry式、量测驱动的工艺校准，并可推广至光子学之外任何需要纳米级CD控制的EBL纳米加工。

title: Stability Study of Photo-inscribed Bragg Gratings in Sapphire Fibers at Very High Temperature
summary: Fiber Bragg gratings inscribed by femtosecond laser in sapphire fibers were subjected to thermal cycling up to 1500$\degree$C. Adding a multimode silica fiber reduces modal interference, improves the quality of the Bragg spectrum and the measurement accuracy. The measurement uncertainty is about 1.9$\degree$C at 1500$\degree$C.

AI.tldr: 飞秒激光刻写的蓝宝石光纤布拉格光栅在1500°C热循环中表现出良好温度响应；引入多模石英光纤抑制模式干涉后，光谱质量与测量精度提升，1500°C处测量不确定度约1.9°C。
AI.motivation: 需要在超高温（氢氧焰、冶金、航空发动机等场景）环境下进行可靠温度测量，而传统石英光纤光栅受限于材料软化温度与掺杂扩散，蓝宝石光纤耐高温但芯径大、模式结构复杂，导致布拉格反射谱存在严重的模式干涉与多峰畸变，影响测量精度，因此需评估其高温稳定性并改善光谱品质。
AI.method: 采用飞秒激光在蓝宝石光纤中直接刻写布拉格光栅（光纤布拉格光栅，FBG），并将其置于热循环条件下测试直至1500°C；在光路中串联接入一段多模石英光纤，用以抑制模式间干涉效应、改善反射谱形态，进而提高布拉格波长（或波长漂移）解调的准确性。
AI.result: 热循环测试至1500°C后，光栅保持可用的温度响应；接入多模石英光纤后布拉格谱峰质量明显改善，模式干涉减弱，测量不确定度在1500°C处约为1.9°C。
AI.conclusion: 飞秒激光刻写的蓝宝石光纤布拉格光栅可用于1500°C量级的超高温温度传感，且通过简单引入多模石英光纤即可有效抑制模式干涉、提升测温精度，为超高温光纤传感提供了一种可行方案。

title: New muon transfer cell for muonic x-ray spectroscopy on microgram-quantity targets based on liquid hydrogen
summary: The muon transfer method allows access to radioactive/rare atomic nuclei for determining their charge radii via muonic x-ray spectroscopy. In this study we present a new muon transfer cell based on liquid hydrogen optimized for low-energy x-ray spectroscopy by employing a thin-walled Mylar cell for the container of the liquid hydrogen. Based on simulations, the present liquid hydrogen cell achieves competitive efficiencies compared to existing devices using the muon transfer method. Additionally, the liquid-hydrogen-based muon transfer setup provides a short timescale for the diffusion process of the muonic hydrogen atoms in the cell, well below 200~ns.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于液氢的新型μ子转移靶室，采用薄壁Mylar容器以适配低能μ子X射线谱学，用于测量放射性/稀有原子核的电荷半径。模拟表明其效率可与现有μ子转移装置竞争，且μ子氢原子扩散时间尺度低于200 ns。
AI.motivation: μ子转移法可借助μ子X射线谱学测定放射性/稀有原子核的电荷半径，但需兼顾低能X射线探测效率与μ子氢原子扩散时间等性能指标，因此需要优化靶室设计。
AI.method: 设计基于液氢的μ子转移靶室，使用薄壁Mylar容器盛装液氢以减小低能X射线的吸收；通过模拟评估该靶室的效率，并与现有μ子转移装置进行对比。
AI.result: 模拟结果显示，该液氢靶室效率与现有μ子转移装置相当，具备竞争力；同时靶室内μ子氢原子扩散过程的特征时间远低于200 ns。
AI.conclusion: 薄壁Mylar液氢μ子转移靶室在效率与时间响应两方面均具有优势，适用于低能μ子X射线谱学测量放射性/稀有核素电荷半径。

title: A photonic-integrated optomechanical mid-infrared detector
summary: Tracking the resonance frequency of a mechanical oscillator is the basis of atomic force microscopy, mass sensing and thermometry. Nanomechanical thermal detectors exploit this principle to sense absorbed radiation, most effectively with tensile-stressed resonators, whose tension converts thermal expansion into a large frequency shift and dilutes dissipation. Approaching their fundamental sensitivity limit, however, has required free-space or fibre-coupled interferometers, hindering compact deployment and scaling to arrays. Here we remove this bottleneck by monolithically integrating a high-Q nanomechanical resonator with a silicon nitride photonic integrated circuit. A tensile-stressed silicon nitride trampoline with an impedance-matched platinum absorber is dispersively coupled to a photonic integrated microresonator beneath it. At room temperature and with microwatt-level optical power, the detector reaches a noise-equivalent power of 3.4 pW/$\sqrt{\rm Hz}$ for broadband thermal radiation (3-12 $μ$m), referred to incident power. Referred to absorbed power, this is within a factor of 1.5 of its fundamental thermal fluctuation limit. Using our detector in a state-of-the-art commercial Fourier-transform infrared spectrometer, we resolve the vibrational fingerprint of a polymer film across 2-20 $μ$m and reach the precision of the built-in pyroelectric detector with about an order of magnitude lower incident power. This architecture opens a route to multiplexed optomechanical focal-plane arrays.

AI.tldr: 本文通过将高Q值氮化硅纳米机械谐振器与氮化硅光子集成电路单片集成，实现了紧凑型光机热探测器，噪声等效功率达3.4 pW/√Hz（3–12 μm），接近其热涨落极限，并可用于商用FTIR光谱仪中低功率高精度分子指纹检测。
AI.motivation: 共振频率追踪是原子力显微镜、质量传感和测温术的基础，纳米机械热探测器利用此原理通过拉伸应力谐振器将热膨胀转为大幅频移并抑制耗散。然而逼近其基本灵敏度极限需要自由空间或光纤耦合干涉仪，阻碍了紧凑部署与阵列化扩展。作者旨在消除这一瓶颈。
AI.method: 将高Q值拉伸应力氮化硅"蹦床"谐振器（集成阻抗匹配铂吸收体）与下方的光子集成微环谐振器色散耦合，实现单片集成的光机热探测架构。在室温与微瓦级光功率下工作，并以入射功率与吸收功率两种基准表征噪声等效功率，随后将该探测器装入最先进的商用傅里叶变换红外光谱仪中测试。
AI.result: 在室温、微瓦级光功率下，宽带热辐射（3–12 μm）的噪声等效功率为3.4 pW/√Hz（以入射功率计）；以吸收功率计时，距其基本热涨落极限仅1.5倍以内。在商用FTIR中，可在2–20 μm范围内分辨聚合物薄膜的振动指纹，并以约低一个数量级的入射功率达到内置热释电探测器的精度。
AI.conclusion: 单片集成的光机热探测架构在不牺牲灵敏度的前提下摆脱了自由空间/光纤干涉仪的束缚，为紧凑化、可扩展的复用光机焦平面阵列铺平道路。

title: A 3D measurement workflow for assessing replication quality and tool degradation in moulded microfluidic channels
comment: 20 pages, 11 figures, 5 tables; supplementary material (19 pages) appended
summary: Mould-based replication, such as injection moulding with 3D-printed inserts, needs a check of how faithfully microchannels are transferred from master to polymer replica. It is usually limited to a width or depth ratio from one cross-section, which misses the sidewall shape and depends on where the section is taken. We present a workflow that assesses the whole channel from 3D scans of master and replica, without sectioning. The scans are registered on a common grid, and each height map is converted into a map of local slope. The correlation of the two slope maps over the channel interior, RQ$_d$, is reported with the channel dimensions and height- and slope-error maps. These outputs separate a change of shape from a change of size and locate it. A user can thereby compare mould materials, detect tool wear, and tell whether a deviation arose before or during moulding. On synthetic channels with known degradation, RQ$_d$ fell steadily as the sidewalls were rounded, whereas the height correlation levelled off. For injection moulding with stereolithography-printed inserts in three resins, RQ$_d$ ranged from 0.17 to 0.91 over fifteen insert-to-part pairs. The height correlation placed the ten well-formed channels within 0.03. Over a twenty-shot run, one insert's RQ$_d$ fell from 0.90 to 0.72 as its sidewalls wore, while its height correlation stayed above 0.93. We developed open-source software that implements the workflow. Because the workflow needs only registered 3D scans of a master and its replica, it can in principle be applied to other mould-based processes.

AI.tldr: 提出一种基于主模与复制品三维扫描的无切片微通道复制度评估流程：将两表面的高度图转为局部坡度图，用通道内部坡度图相关性 RQ_d 作为保形指标，并配套高度误差与坡度误差图及开源软件。
AI.motivation: 注塑等模具复制工艺（如3D打印嵌件注塑）需要评价微通道从母模到聚合物复制品的保真度。传统方法仅取单一横截面计算宽度或深度比，既丢失侧壁形状信息，又依赖取截面位置。
AI.method: 对主模与复制品进行三维扫描并配准到统一网格；将每张高度图转换为局部坡度图；在通道内部区域计算两坡度图的相关系数 RQ_d；同时输出通道尺寸、高度误差图与坡度误差图；并用已知退化程度的合成通道及SL打印嵌件注塑实验（三种树脂、十五组嵌件-制件、二十次注射磨损试验）验证。
AI.result: 合成通道侧壁逐渐圆化时 RQ_d 单调下降，而高度相关性趋于饱和；十五组注塑配对中 RQ_d 为 0.17–0.91，高度相关性将十个成形良好的通道差异压缩在 0.03 内；二十次注射过程中某嵌件 RQ_d 由 0.90 降至 0.72（侧壁磨损），而高度相关性仍高于 0.93。
AI.conclusion: RQ_d 对形状变化（如侧壁圆化、磨损）敏感，优于高度相关性，可分离并定位"形状改变"与"尺寸改变"；有助于比较模具材料、检测工具磨损、判断偏差发生在成型之前还是过程中；因仅需配准的三维扫描，理论上可推广至其他模具类工艺；相关软件已开源。

title: Towards Myocardial Infarction Diagnosis: An Investigation into Machine Learning and Deep Learning Algorithms using ECG Data
comment: 18 pages, 7 figures, 3 tables. Based on the authors' undergraduate thesis at BRAC University (2023)
summary: Myocardial Infarction (MI) is a severe and potentially fatal cardiac condition caused by myocardial injury due to ischemia, and timely detection can substantially reduce its mortality. Electrocardiography (ECG) is the primary diagnostic modality for MI, but manual interpretation is susceptible to human error. In this work, we propose Visionary V2, a multi-step, adaptive filtration method for ECG signal normalization, and use it to study machine learning (ML) and deep learning (DL) approaches to MI detection on the PTB Diagnostic ECG Database using all 15 available leads. On statistical features extracted from the filtered signals, such as the R-R interval, a Bagging ensemble of decision trees reaches 96.6% accuracy, compared with 87.7% when the signals are processed with BioSPPy. We further generate an image dataset from the filtered signals, on which a custom ResNet-50 misclassifies only 1 of 7,000 validation images and a custom CNN reaches an F1 score of about 98.7%. Finally, we apply LIME, Grad-CAM and Integrated Gradients to verify that the image models attend to the ECG waveform rather than the background. These results indicate that careful signal normalization combined with ML and DL models can support fast and accurate automated MI screening.

AI.tldr: 提出多步自适应滤波方法 Visionary V2 对 ECG 信号归一化，在 PTB 数据库全 15 导联上结合 ML/DL 实现高精度心肌梗死检测，并用可解释性方法验证模型关注波形本身。
AI.motivation: 心肌梗死（MI）致死率高，及时检测可显著降低死亡率；ECG 是主要诊断手段，但人工判读易出错，因此需要快速准确的自动化筛查方案。
AI.method: 提出 Visionary V2 多步自适应滤波用于 ECG 信号归一化；在 PTB Diagnostic ECG Database 全部 15 个导联上，基于滤波信号的统计特征（如 R-R 间期）训练决策树 Bagging 集成；同时将滤波信号转为图像数据集，训练定制 ResNet-50 与定制 CNN；最后用 LIME、Grad-CAM 和 Integrated Gradients 做可解释性分析。
AI.result: 统计特征上决策树 Bagging 达 96.6% 准确率，而 BioSPPy 处理仅为 87.7%；图像数据集中定制 ResNet-50 在 7000 张验证图像上仅误分类 1 张，定制 CNN 的 F1 约 98.7%；可解释性分析证实图像模型关注 ECG 波形而非背景。
AI.conclusion: 细致的信号归一化结合 ML 与 DL 模型，可支撑快速、准确的自动化 MI 筛查；多步自适应滤波是提升性能的关键因素。

title: Simulation-Derived Angular Migration in Volcanic Muography
summary: Transmission muography usually treats each angular bin as a straight line of sight through the target. Multiple Coulomb scattering can break this mapping by changing the muon direction in rock. We introduce CABRIALES, a reduced model that represents this effect as migration between source and destination angular bins. The input muons are generated with a conditional normalizing flow trained on ARTI simulations, selected with a continuous-slowing-down range threshold, and deflected using angular distributions derived from Geant4. We apply the model to four observation points at Cerro Machin volcano in Colombia. Among the muons selected by the transmission threshold, 41.4-45.1% move to a different 2.5-degree bin within the field of view, while 20.7-24.3% reach a different rock-intersecting angular bin associated with a longer rock path in the terrain model. For muons with energies within 5% above the transmission threshold, the changed-bin fraction increases to 67.4-81.3%. Destination maps further show that events arriving from shorter assigned paths can form a large share of the modeled population in some rock-intersecting bins. These results quantify angular redistribution before detector response; they do not represent net count changes or density bias.

AI.tldr: 提出约化模型CABRIALES，将多重库仑散射对透射式缪子成像的影响建模为源-目的角度bin之间的迁移，并在哥伦比亚Cerro Machín火山的4个观测点上量化了角度重分布的量级。
AI.motivation: 传统透射式缪子成像把每个角度bin视为穿过目标的一条直线视线，但多重库仑散射会改变缪子在岩石中的方向，破坏这一直线映射假设，需要用可计算的模型评估该效应造成的角度重分布程度。
AI.method: CABRIALES为约化模型：输入缪子由在ARTI模拟上训练的条件归一化流生成，并按连续慢化射程阈值筛选；再用Geant4导出的角度分布施加偏转，把散射效应表示为源角度bin到目的角度bin的迁移；应用于Cerro Machín火山4个观测点。
AI.result: 在通过透射阈值的缪子中，41.4–45.1%迁移到视场内另一个2.5°bin；20.7–24.3%到达地形模型中岩石路径更长的另一个与岩石相交的角度bin。能量在透射阈值以上5%以内的缪子，换bin比例升至67.4–81.3%。目的映射还显示，在部分与岩石相交的bin中，来自被指派更短路径的事件可占建模总体的较大份额。
AI.conclusion: 结果在探测器响应之前量化了角度重分布，说明直线视线近似的偏差不可忽略；但作者强调这些结果不代表净计数变化或密度偏差。

title: An Eigenmode Expansion Framework for Bi-Directional Multimode Nonlinear Mixing Processes
summary: An approach to simulating complex photonic systems is the eigenmode expansion method, in which scattering matrices are used to model and track the electric field in layered media. In this work, we formulate parametric nonlinear processes within the eigenmode expansion framework, enabling the simulation of nonlinear generation in varying photonic systems. This new simulation method includes both classical nonlinear processes and their quantum counterparts, including spontaneous parametric down-conversion and spontaneous four-wave mixing.

AI.tldr: 本文将参量非线性过程纳入本征模式展开（EEM）框架，通过散射矩阵建模分层介质中的电场，可同时模拟经典非线性过程及其量子对应过程（自发参量下转换、自发四波混频）。
AI.motivation: 复杂光子系统的仿真通常依赖本征模式展开与散射矩阵方法，但该框架此前主要针对线性分层介质中的场传播，缺乏对参量非线性产生过程的统一处理能力；因此需要一个能把非线性（含量子）过程纳入同一框架的仿真方法。
AI.method: 在本征模式展开框架内建立参量非线性过程的公式化描述，以散射矩阵对分层介质中的电场进行建模与追踪，从而在变化的各类光子系统中统一处理非线性产生；该表述同时涵盖经典非线性过程与量子对应过程，包括自发参量下转换与自发四波混频。
AI.result: 提出了一种新的仿真方法，能够在本征模式展开-B 散射矩阵体系中模拟多种光子系统中的非线性产生，并同时覆盖经典非线性过程与自发参量下转换、自发四波混频等量子过程。
AI.conclusion: 将参量非线性过程整合进本征模式展开框架，可扩展该方法的适用范围，使其成为兼具经典与量子非线性光子器件仿真的统一工具。

title: 800 $^\circ$C Air-Ambient Operation of Extreme-Bandgap Al$_{x}$Ga$_{1-x}$N (x>0.6) Digital and Random-Alloy Channel HEMTs
summary: This work demonstrates the high-temperature (room to 800 $^\circ$C) operation of thin Al$_{0.62}$Ga$_{0.38}$N digital alloy (DA) short-period superlattice (SPSL), and random alloy (RA) Al$_{0.64}$Ga$_{0.36}$N channel MOSHEMTs on sapphire. The RA devices employ a doped $n^{+}$-85%-Al barrier and a highly doped $n^{++}$-Al$_{0.86\rightarrow0.20}$Ga$_{0.14\rightarrow0.80}$N reverse-graded layer (RGL) for surface ohmic contact formation, whereas the DA devices employ a binary AlN barrier and selectively regrown $n^{++}$-GaN source/drain contacts. At 800 $^\circ$C, the DA channel devices exhibit better thermal stability: their saturated drain current decreases from 460 to 172 mA/mm (62.6%) compared with 338 to 98 mA/mm (71.0%) for the RA channel, and a lower subthreshold swing (459 for DA versus 550 mV/dec for RA). All tested DA devices also exhibit superior threshold-voltage stability ($<\pm 10\%$ versus $>\pm 19\%$ for RA) and maintain an ON/OFF current ratio >$10^4$ at 800 $^\circ$C, compared with ~$10^3$ for RA, thus establishing the DA channel HEMTs as a promising new platform for high-temperature electronics.

AI.tldr: 该文比较了蓝宝石衬底上AlGaN数字合金（DA）短周期超晶格沟道与随机合金（RA）沟道MOSHEMT从室温到800 °C的高温特性，DA器件热稳定性与可靠性更优。
AI.motivation: 面向高温电子学应用，需要评估不同沟道结构（数字合金短周期超晶格 vs. 随机合金）在极端高温下的器件性能与可靠性差异，寻找更优的高温HEMT平台。
AI.method: 在蓝宝石衬底上制备Al0.62Ga0.38N DA SPSL沟道与Al0.64Ga0.36N RA沟道MOSHEMT并对比。RA器件采用掺杂n⁺-85%-Al势垒层与高掺杂n⁺⁺-Al0.86→0.20Ga0.14→0.80N反向渐变层（RGL）形成表面欧姆接触；DA器件采用二元AlN势垒层与选择性再生长n⁺⁺-GaN源漏接触。测试温度范围室温至800 °C。
AI.result: 800 °C下DA沟道器件热稳定性更佳：饱和漏电流由460降至172 mA/mm（降幅62.6%），RA由338降至98 mA/mm（降幅71.0%）；亚阈值摆幅DA为459 mV/dec，优于RA的550 mV/dec。所有DA器件阈值电压稳定性更优（<±10% vs. RA >±19%），且800 °C下维持ON/OFF电流比>10⁴（RA约10³）。
AI.conclusion: DA沟道HEMT在高温下表现出更低电流退化、更小SS、更稳定阈值电压和更高开关比，是高温电子学极具前景的新型器件平台。

title: Medical Image Analysis with Machine Learning (MEDiml): Strategies for Simpler Radiomics
comment: 11 pages, 3 figures, 2 tables. Software paper. Full reference manual: arXiv:2610.29666 . Software, documentation, tutorials, and resources are available at https://www.mediml.app
summary: Radiomics extracts quantitative features describing tumor shape, intensity, and texture from medical images to build models that predict clinical outcomes. However, large feature sets increase the risk of overfitting in small datasets, and building an end-to-end workflow often requires programming expertise. We present MEDiml (Medical Image Analysis with Machine Learning), open-source radiomics software available as a Python package (MEDiml-pkg) and a no-code desktop application (MEDiml-app). Both run on the same computational engine, and code generation exports graphically configured workflows as executable Python code. Feature extraction follows the Image Biomarker Standardization Initiative (IBSI) standards. MEDiml is built around complexity minimization: features are grouped into levels of increasing complexity (morphological, intensity, textural,l and filter-based), a model is trained at each level, and the simplest level not significantly outperformed by more complex ones is retained. Applied to five oncological datasets (2,104 scans), MEDiml achieved AUCs of 0.65 to 0.82, with morphological or intensity features sufficient in four of the five tasks. Resources: www.mediml.app.

AI.tldr: 本文提出开源影像组学软件MEDiml，含Python包(MEDiml-pkg)与无代码桌面版(MEDiml-app)，共享同一计算引擎，并支持将图形化流程导出为可执行Python代码；特征提取遵循IBSI标准。其核心设计是"复杂度最小化"：按形态学、强度、纹理、滤波特征分级建模，保留未被更复杂层级显著超越的最简层级。在五个肿瘤数据集(2,104例扫描)上AUC为0.65–0.82，其中四项任务仅用形态学或强度特征即足够。
AI.motivation: 影像组学从医学图像中提取大量定量特征以预测临床结局，但特征维度过高在小样本数据上易过拟合；且构建端到端流程通常需要编程能力，限制了临床与研究人员的可及性。
AI.method: 开发开源软件MEDiml，提供Python包与无代码桌面应用两种前端，共用同一计算引擎，并支持"代码生成"将图形化配置的工作流导出为可执行Python代码；特征提取遵循IBSI标准。建模采用"复杂度最小化"策略：将特征按复杂度递增分为形态学、强度、纹理、滤波四层，逐层训练模型，选择未被更复杂层显著优于的最简层作为最终模型。
AI.result: 在五个肿瘤学数据集(共2,104例扫描)上，MEDiml取得AUC 0.65–0.82；其中四个任务中，仅使用形态学或强度特征即可达到足够性能。
AI.conclusion: MEDiml通过双层前端(代码/无代码)降低影像组学工作流的构建门槛，并以分层建模的复杂度最小化原则在保持预测性能的同时缓解小样本过拟合，实证表明更简单、可解释的特征层级在多数任务中已足够。

title: Simulating scintillation detector responses with OpenMC and pyMPPost: a track-based coupling verified against MCNPX-PoliMi
summary: Simulations of the detector response are essential for the design and analysis of neutron and photon measurements in nuclear nonproliferation, safeguards, and active interrogation studies. MCNPX-PoliMi, combined with the post-processor MPPost and its Python implementation pyMPPost, is a well-established and validated framework for this purpose. Its detector models, however, are not available to users of the open-source Monte Carlo code OpenMC, which does not write an equivalent collision-level output. This work couples OpenMC to pyMPPost, allowing the open-source community to use the detector models already implemented and validated in pyMPPost without modifying either code. A Python class, $\texttt{TrackAnalyzer}$, reads the particle tracks written by OpenMC, reconstructs the interactions in the detector material along with the target nuclide and writes them in the MCNPX-PoliMi collision file format. The method relies only on the track output and is therefore applicable to any OpenMC version that writes particle tracks, including the development branch with photonuclear physics used in this work. The coupling was verified code to code against MCNPX-PoliMi for a trans-stilbene and a $^{4}$He scintillator exposed to $^{252}$Cf and deuterium-deuterium fusion neutron sources, and for a NaI(Tl) scintillator exposed to $^{137}$Cs and $^{152}$Eu photon sources. The total number of pulses agrees within $\pm$1\% in all cases, and the light-output spectra agree within a few percent in the covered spectral domain. By making the detector response models of pyMPPost available within a fully open-source simulation chain, this work extends detector response studies with OpenMC to nuclear nonproliferation and active interrogation applications, including those involving photonuclear reactions, and provides an accessible tool for education and training in radiation detection.

AI.tldr: 该工作将开源蒙特卡罗程序OpenMC与探测器响应后处理工具pyMPPost耦合，通过TrackAnalyzer类把OpenMC粒子径迹转换为MCNPX-PoliMi碰撞文件格式，从而在完全开源链条中复用已验证的探测器响应模型。
AI.motivation: MCNPX-PoliMi配合MPPost/pyMPPost是核不扩散、保障监督与主动探测研究中探测器响应模拟的成熟框架，但其探测器模型不对OpenMC用户开放；OpenMC亦不输出等效的碰撞级数据。因此需要在不修改两套代码的前提下打通两者。
AI.method: 开发Python类TrackAnalyzer：读取OpenMC输出的粒子径迹，重构探测器材料内的相互作用及目标核素，并写成MCNPX-PoliMi碰撞文件格式。方法仅依赖径迹输出，故适用于任何输出粒子径迹的OpenMC版本（含本工作使用的带光核物理的开发分支）。
AI.result: 对反式二苯乙烯与4He闪烁体在252Cf和D-D聚变中子源下、以及NaI(Tl)在137Cs和152Eu光子源下，与MCNPX-PoliMi进行code-to-code验证：总脉冲数在±1%内一致，光输出谱在覆盖能区内相差数个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 该耦合使pyMPPost的探测器响应模型可用于全开源模拟链，将OpenMC的探测器响应研究拓展至核不扩散与主动探测（含光核反应）应用，并为辐射探测教学培训提供易用工具。

title: Automated identification of quasi-BIC modes in disordered resonator chains using spatial field envelopes and resonance descriptors
summary: Structural disorder turns bound states in the continuum (BICs) into quasi-BIC resonances and mixes them with spectrally close eigenmodes, so the target mode must be identified anew in every disorder realization. We develop an automated procedure for this task and test it on a chain of 50 ceramic disks, where disorder reorders the standing-wave eigenmodes at the edge of the BIC band: at disorder amplitude $σ=0.05$, the highest-quality-factor ($Q$) mode is the target in only 45\% of realizations, and above $σ\approx0.06$ the highest-frequency mode is no longer the target. The target is identified from the spatial envelope of its field and its resonance parameters by an ensemble of a convolutional--recurrent neural network and two gradient-boosted decision-tree models. On 299 held-out realizations, the ensemble selects the target in 82.6\% of cases, against 60.9\% and 49.5\% for the highest-frequency and highest-$Q$ rules, and in 69.5\% of cases for $σ\ge0.09$, where the best of these rules reaches 57.6\%. The mean $Q$ of the selected modes follows that of the manually labeled modes ($\langle Q\rangle\proptoσ^{k}$, $k=-0.80\pm0.05$ versus $-0.86\pm0.04$). After adaptation on 50 labeled realizations, the workflow identifies the quasi-BIC of a Ge$_2$Sb$_2$Te$_5$ bar metasurface in 98--100\% of labeled cases, including a lossy phase where $Q$ does not distinguish the mode.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种自动化流程，用于在结构无序下重新识别连续域束缚态（BIC）所演化的准BIC目标模式，并在50个陶瓷圆盘链及Ge2Sb2Te5条形超表面上验证其有效性。
AI.motivation: 结构无序会使BIC转变为准BIC共振，并与光谱邻近的本征模式混合，导致目标模式在每一次无序实现中都需重新辨识；而传统依据最高频率或最高Q值的判别规则在强无序下失效。
AI.method: 构建由卷积-循环神经网络与两个梯度提升决策树模型组成的集成模型，依据模式场的空间包络与共振参数进行判别；在50个陶瓷圆盘链的299个留出实现上测试，并在50个标注实现上对Ge2Sb2Te5条形超表面进行适配。
AI.result: 在σ=0.05时最高Q模式仅在45%实现中为目标，σ≳0.06时最高频模式不再为目标；集成模型在299个留出实现中识别率达82.6%（最高频规则60.9%、最高Q规则49.5%），在σ≥0.09时为69.5%（最优规则仅57.6%）；所选模式平均Q与人工标注一致（⟨Q⟩∝σ^k，k=-0.80±0.05对-0.86±0.04）；适配后在Ge2Sb2Te5超表面标注案例中识别率达98–100%，包括Q无法区分的损耗相位。
AI.conclusion: 基于场空间包络与共振参数的机器学习集成方法可鲁棒、自动地追踪无序下的准BIC目标模式，优于传统经验规则，并具备跨体系迁移能力。

title: A guide to enriched continuum modeling: advances on wave propagation in metamaterials through the relaxed micromorphic framework
summary: This contribution provides a systematic framework for modeling the dispersive behavior of mechanical metamaterials by an enriched continua approach using the relaxed micromorphic model (RMM). We give the identification of its frequency-independent constitutive parameters from Bloch-Floquet dispersion data of the periodic metamaterial by combining analytical relations for characteristic features with a subsequent numerical optimization. Particular emphasis is placed on the underlying structure and limitations of the resulting dispersion relations, including their cut-offs, and asymptotic behavior. Finally, the transition from infinite periodic media to finite-size specimens is addressed, highlighting the role of the microscopic unit-cell cut and discussing null-Lagrangian contributions, effective interface forces, and surface Lagrangians as approaches to incorporate boundary effects.

AI.tldr: 该文提出用松弛微极（relaxed micromorphic）模型这一富集连续体方法系统刻画力学超材料的色散行为：结合特征解析关系与数值优化，从Bloch-Floquet色散数据辨识频率无关本构参数，并分析色散关系的结构、截止频率与渐近行为，最后讨论由无限周期介质到有限尺寸试件的过渡及边界效应建模途径。
AI.motivation: 力学超材料的色散特性源于微结构，直接对周期单元做Bloch-Floquet分析计算代价高且难以用于宏观结构分析；需要由少数频率无关本构参数控制的富集连续体模型，并明确其适用性与局限，同时解决从无限周期介质到有限尺寸试件（存在边界效应）的衔接问题。
AI.method: 采用松弛微极模型（RMM）建立色散建模框架：结合解析关系（对色散曲线特征如渐近斜率、截止频率的解析表达）与后续数值优化，从Bloch-Floquet色散数据辨识频率无关本构参数；进一步分析所得色散关系的结构、截止频率与渐近行为；并在有限尺寸情形下考察微观单胞截断的作用，比较null-Lagrangian贡献、等效界面力与表面Lagrangian等边界效应处理方式。
AI.result: 给出系统化的参数辨识流程（解析关系+数值优化），可从周期超材料的Bloch-Floquet色散数据获得频率无关本构参数；阐明所导出色散关系的结构特征、截止频率及渐近行为及其局限；指出单胞截断在有限试件中的重要性，并梳理null-Lagrangian贡献、等效界面力与表面Lagrangian等刻画边界效应的思路。
AI.conclusion: 松弛微极模型可作为力学超材料色散行为的有效富集连续体框架，其频率无关参数的辨识流程清晰可行，但模型色散关系存在结构性与渐近性限制；从无限周期介质向有限尺寸试件过渡时需显式考虑微观单胞截断与表面/界面效应，相关边界处理方案仍有待完善。

title: EUReCA: End-to-End Unified CBCT Reconstruction Across Clinical Acquisitions
summary: Cone-beam computed tomography (CBCT) is widely used for image-guided radiotherapy, but reducing the number of projections to lower dose and scan time makes reconstruction increasingly ill-posed. We present EUReCA (End-to-end Unified REconstruction across Clinical Acquisitions), a geometry-aware feed-forward model for variable-view clinical linac CBCT. For a given acquisition trajectory, EUReCA accepts 8-100 projections with a single set of weights, without view-count-specific retraining; the same architecture and training recipe extend unchanged to other clinical trajectories. It combines learned projection features with an in-frame Feldkamp-Davis-Kress (FDK) reconstruction. The model encodes each projection with a shared multiscale backbone, back-projects features into multiresolution 3D grids using the acquisition geometry, aggregates variable numbers of views at fixed computational cost, and refines the volume with a global 3D transformer and multilevel decoder. On simulated data, EUReCA achieved 29.9-33.2 dB PSNR with 10-100 views and outperformed all applicable feed-forward baselines; it also exceeded iterative optimization-based methods while running orders of magnitude faster. On 15 measured patient CBCT scans evaluated against vendor reconstructions, EUReCA achieved the best performance at every tested view count. These results suggest that geometry-aware, measurement-anchored feed-forward reconstruction can provide a practical and flexible foundation for variable-view linac CBCT.

AI.tldr: 提出几何感知的前馈重建模型 EUReCA，用单一权重支持 8–100 视角的临床直线加速器 CBCT 重建，可跨采集轨迹通用。
AI.motivation: CBCT 广泛用于图像引导放疗，但减少投影数以降低剂量与扫描时间会使重建问题更加病态，且临床采集视角数变化大、轨迹多样，需要无需按视角数重新训练的通用重建方法。
AI.method: 将学习到的投影特征与帧内 FDK 重建结合：用共享多尺度主干编码每个投影，借助采集几何将特征反投影到多分辨率 3D 网格，在固定计算代价下聚合可变数量视角，再由全局 3D Transformer 与多级解码器精化体数据；同一架构与训练方案可无缝扩展到其他临床轨迹。
AI.result: 仿真数据上，10–100 视角下 PSNR 达 29.9–33.2 dB，优于所有适用的前馈基线，并超过迭代优化方法且快数个数量级；15 例实测患者 CBCT 对比厂商重建，在每个测试视角数下均取得最佳性能。
AI.conclusion: 几何感知、以测量为锚的前馈重建可作为可变视角直线加速器 CBCT 的实用且灵活的基础框架。

title: Position- and Temperature-Dependent Responsivity in a KID-Based Phonon-Mediated Detector
comment: 37 Pages, 21 figures. Prepared for journal submission
summary: We report on the position- and temperature-dependent response of a kinetic inductance phonon-mediated (KIPM) detector. To study position-dependence, we used a controllable mirror attached to a micro-electromechanical system (MEMS) to steer optical light with a 100 $μ$m spot size over the backside of the cryogenic detector. With both pulsed and continuous operation of the LED, we observe features of the detector housing and find that the signal is strongest when the LED is pointed directly at the KID. The "off-KID" response is measured to be 34% of the "on-KID" response and is largely independent of direction. We model phonon propagation and collection in the KIPM detector with G4CMP and assert that the isotropic angular dependence is unlikely to be due to discrete phonon absorption "sinks", such as the microwave feedline or the device mounting points, but can be explained instead by an isotropic energy loss in the crystal. We furthermore utilize the temperature flexibility of the MEMS and KIPM detector system to investigate temperature-dependent responsivity, both at the sensor level (i.e., frequency shifts in the KID) and at the detector level (i.e., position dependence). We fit the KID's response to a two-component heat capacity and present the model as an alternative way to understand the KID's response to absorbed energy. We show on- and off-KID data at a range of temperatures and show that the phonon dynamics are not temperature dependent. We comment on the resulting implication for KID dynamics and design improvements.

AI.tldr: 该文报道了动能电感声子中介（KIPM）探测器的位置依赖与温度依赖响应：利用MEMS驱动反射镜将100 μm光斑扫描到低温探测器背面，发现正对KID时信号最强，"离KID"响应约为"正KID"响应的34%且基本与方位无关；用G4CMP模拟表明各向同性角依赖源于晶体内各向同性能量损失而非离散声子吸收"汇"；温度依赖测量显示声子动力学不随温度变化。
AI.motivation: KIPM探测器（以KID为读出、声子为中介）对吸收能量的响应机制尚不清晰，位置依赖与温度依赖的定量表征缺失，需要区分几何/离散吸收汇与晶体本征能量损失对响应均匀性的贡献，并为KID动力学建模与器件设计改进提供依据。
AI.method: 将可控反射镜集成于MEMS上，在低温环境下用100 μm光斑扫描探测器背面，LED以脉冲与连续两种模式驱动；测量"正KID"与"离KID"响应及其方位依赖；用G4CMP进行声子传播与收集建模；借助MEMS与KIPM的温度可调性，在传感器层面（KID频移）与探测器层面（位置依赖）测量温度依赖响应，并将KID响应拟合为双分量热容模型。
AI.result: 观察到探测器外壳特征信号，正对KID照射时信号最强；离KID响应为34%（相对于正KID），且与方向基本无关；G4CMP模拟表明这种各向同性角依赖不太可能由微波馈线、器件安装点等离散声子吸收"汇"造成，而可由晶体中的各向同性能量损失解释；在多个温度下正KID与离KID数据表明声子动力学不随温度变化；双分量热容模型可描述KID对吸收能量的响应。
AI.conclusion: 声子收集的各向同性源于晶体本征的各向同性能量损失；声子动力学无显著温度依赖，意味着KID响应可用双分量热容框架理解；结果对KID动力学建模与KIPM探测器设计改进（如减少离KID能量损失、优化收集效率）具有指导意义。

title: Drift-induced nonreciprocity in image-polariton-mediated dipole emission
summary: Electrical current bias offers a magnet-free route to nonreciprocal light propagation at the nanoscale. Here, we theoretically explore drift-induced nonreciprocity in graphene heterostructures containing hexagonal boron nitride (hBN), where graphene plasmons interact with hBN phonon polaritons in the infrared. Both the random-phase approximation and the Boltzmann transport equation are used to characterize the nonlocal optical response of drift-biased graphene. We compare graphene on hBN with an image-polaritonic structure comprising graphene, a thin hBN spacer, and a gold substrate. Carrier drift produces pronounced directional shifts of the polariton dispersion, while coupling to hBN phonon polaritons strongly modifies the nonreciprocal response. In the image-polaritonic structure, the graphene polaritons become up to twice as confined while retaining a comparable Fizeau shift. The nonreciprocal polariton dispersion produces directional near-field emission and nonreciprocal dipole-dipole interactions, the latter quantified through the cross density of optical states, reaching a left-right dissymmetry of up to ~40%. Our results identify image polaritons in drift-biased graphene as a compact, electrically tunable platform for directional coupling between quantum emitters at the nanoscale.

AI.tldr: 通过电流偏置诱导载流子漂移，在石墨烯/hBN异质结构中实现无磁非互易等离激元，并利用镜像极化激元增强局域性同时保持可比拟的Fizeau频移。
AI.motivation: 电偏置提供了一种无需磁场的纳米尺度非互易光传输途径；需厘清石墨烯等离激元与hBN声子极化激元耦合及镜像结构对漂移诱导非互易性的影响。
AI.method: 理论上采用随机相位近似（RPA）与玻尔兹曼输运方程刻画漂移偏置石墨烯的非局域光学响应；对比石墨烯/hBN与"石墨烯—薄hBN间隔层—金衬底"的镜像极化激元结构，分析等离激元与hBN声子极化激元的耦合及方向性色散移动。
AI.result: 载流子漂移引起极化激元色散显著的方向性移动；与hBN声子极化激元耦合强烈改变非互易响应；镜像结构中石墨烯极化激元局域性提升最多约2倍而Fizeau频移保持相当；产生方向性近场发射与非互易偶极-偶极相互作用，以交叉光学态密度量化，左右不对称度可达约40%。
AI.conclusion: 漂移偏置石墨烯中的镜像极化激元构成紧凑、电可调的平台，可用于纳米尺度量子发射体的定向耦合。

title: Flow Matching for Fluctuation-Based Fluorescence Super-Resolution
comment: 5 pages, 3 figures, submitted to ISBI 2027. Code available at https://github.com/cozzalberto/flow_fluo
summary: Fluctuation-based super-resolution techniques are an appealing alternative to single-molecule and structured-illumination microscopy, as they adapt to standard acquisition settings and exploit the independent stochastic fluctuations of fluorophores across a sequence of frames. However, most existing approaches lack an explicit model of the acquisition process and provide only relative intensity estimates, limiting quantitative analyses. In this work, we combine model-based and generative approaches to exploit the full stochastic information in the sequence, proposing a reconstruction framework built on flow matching and a double-Poisson forward model accounting for blinking, blur, under-sampling and noise. The method alternates two steps: a flow matching model first learns the distribution of the acquired data; then, the sample and the background are jointly estimated by minimising a Kullback-Leibler divergence between observed and simulated distributions via regularised proximal gradient steps. On simulated and real Argolight data, the method resolves lines separated by 120 nm, outperforming SACD and eSRRF.

AI.tldr: 提出结合流匹配（flow matching）与双泊松前向模型的超分辨重建框架，交替学习数据分布与联合估计样品和背景，在Argolight数据上分辨120 nm线，优于SACD与eSRRF。
AI.motivation: 基于涨落的超分辨技术适配常规采集设置、利用荧光团在帧序列中的独立随机涨落，是单分子与结构光照明的有吸引力替代方案；但多数现有方法缺乏对采集过程的显式建模，仅给出相对强度估计，限制了定量分析。
AI.method: 构建基于flow matching的重建框架，采用双泊松前向模型刻画闪烁、模糊、欠采样与噪声。方法交替两步：(1) 用flow matching学习采集数据的分布；(2) 通过正则化近端梯度步，最小化观测分布与模拟分布间的KL散度，联合估计样品与背景。属于模型驱动与生成式方法结合的思路，以利用序列中的全部随机信息。
AI.result: 在模拟数据与真实Argolight数据上，可分辨相隔120 nm的线条，性能优于SACD和eSRRF。
AI.conclusion: 显式前向建模与生成式分布学习的结合，使涨落超分辨在提供绝对（定量）强度估计的同时达到120 nm分辨率，优于现有基线方法。

title: A flexible electronics and DAQ system for the Timepix4 ASIC
summary: The INFN Data Acquisition system (IDAQ) is designed for data-driven readout of the Timepix4 ASIC, supporting simultaneous time-of-arrival and time-over-threshold measurements with nanosecond precision. The system architecture combines dedicated hardware for high-speed serial data transmission, FPGA-based data processing, and a Trigger Logic Unit for synchronization and timing distribution. It operates in continuous streaming and triggered modes, ensuring low-latency and high-throughput performance. The system has been deployed in test-beam campaigns within the 4DPHOTON project, demonstrating stable operation, precise timing alignment, and reliable data handling under high-rate conditions.

AI.tldr: IDAQ是一套面向Timepix4 ASIC的INFN数据采集系统，以数据驱动方式读出，结合高速串行传输硬件、FPGA数据处理与触发逻辑单元，支持连续流与触发两种模式，并在4DPHOTON项目测试束实验中验证了稳定运行、精确时间对齐与高计数率下的可靠数据传输。
AI.motivation: Timepix4具备纳秒级时间分辨率，可同时测量到达时间与过阈时间，但需要与之匹配的高速、低延迟、可同步的读出系统；现有读出方案难以在高计数率下同时保证低延迟、高吞吐与时间同步，因此需要专门设计的数据驱动采集系统。
AI.method: 采用IDAQ架构：专用硬件负责高速串行数据传输，FPGA完成数据处理，触发逻辑单元（TLU）负责同步与时钟/时间分配；系统提供连续流式与触发式两种工作模式，实现数据驱动读出。
AI.result: 系统在4DPHOTON项目的测试束实验中部署运行，表现出稳定工作、精确的时间对齐，以及在高计数率条件下可靠的数据处理能力，满足低延迟与高吞吐的性能要求。
AI.conclusion: IDAQ为Timepix4提供了一套可行且经验证的数据驱动读出方案，适用于高计数率、需纳秒级时间测量的实验场景，并具备进一步推广应用的潜力。

title: Confocal ellipsoidal displaced Gregorian structure for stand-off millimeter-wave imaging
summary: Reflective-based structures are favorable candidates as the optical section of millimeter-wave and terahertz (THz) stand-off imaging systems due to decreasing frequency-dependent losses and aberrations compared to refractive-based counterparts. In this paper, we propose a simple confocal ellipsoidal displaced Gregorian (CEDG) dual-mirror configuration for stand-off imaging systems that exhibits superior performance in terms of mitigating optical blockage and enabling object scanning. The proposed structure is composed of a standard elliptical main mirror, which focuses the emanated rays on the focal plane, and a modified secondary mirror (SM) that reduces the optical blockage effect and improves the imaging performance of the structure. A detailed step-by-step procedure is proposed for constructing the structure, followed by an analytical study and deriving closed-form design equations. By performing ray tracing simulations, it is observed that the optical blockage of the proposed CEDG structure is reduced compared with the standard Gregorian. Also, the resolution and the depth-of-focus (DoF) are obtained at 1.5 cm and 49.7 cm in full-wave simulations, respectively, demonstrating good agreement with the theoretical predictions. Moreover, the scanning performance of the CEDG structure is investigated by utilizing the tilting of the SM and feed point displacement, presenting a maximum field-of-view (FoV) of 40 cm at a distance of 3 m, which is acceptable for modern practical stand-off imaging systems. Finally, the capability of the proposed structure for tuning the stand-off distance by lateral displacement of the feeding source is verified. As a result, the proposed compact, low-cost configuration shows potential for practical mm-wave and THz stand-off imaging systems.

AI.tldr: 提出共焦椭球偏置格雷戈里（CEDG）双镜结构用于毫米波/太赫兹远距离成像，抑制光遮挡并支持物体扫描。
AI.motivation: 反射式结构因频率相关损耗与像差随频率降低而优于折射式，适合作为毫米波与太赫兹远距离成像系统的光学部分；但标准格雷戈里结构的副镜会造成光遮挡，且需要便于物体扫描的构型。
AI.method: 采用标准椭球主镜聚焦光线至焦平面，配合改进型副镜（SM）以减小遮挡；给出分步构建设计流程、解析研究与闭式设计方程；通过光线追迹仿真比较遮挡，通过全波仿真评估分辨率与焦深（DoF），并利用副镜倾斜与馈源位移研究扫描性能及远距离调谐能力。
AI.result: 光线追迹显示CEDG结构相比标准格雷戈里结构光遮挡降低；全波仿真得分辨率1.5 cm、焦深49.7 cm，与理论预测吻合；副镜倾斜与馈源平移实现3 m处最大40 cm视场（FoV）；侧向移动馈源可调谐远距离。
AI.conclusion: 该紧凑、低成本CEDG构型在毫米波与太赫兹远距离成像系统方面具有实用潜力。

title: Looping Kooshball: Improved k-space coverage for silent fMRI using 3D coherence trajectories
summary: Functional MRI (fMRI) is widely used to characterize brain activity and connectivity, but conventional gradient-echo echo-planar imaging produces high acoustic sound-pressure levels by operating gradient hardware near its limits. Scanner noise can increase anxiety and motion, particularly in noise-sensitive populations, and can evoke auditory responses that confound both task-based and resting-state measurements. Looping Star (LS) is a near-silent, T2*-weighted acquisition that uses slowly varying gradients and multiplexed, temporally staggered coherences. Conventional LS rotates planar encoding trajectories across shots to achieve three-dimensional coverage. Because these planes intersect near the center of k-space, sampling is dense at low spatial frequencies but sparse and nonuniform at the periphery, limiting efficiency when relatively few shots are combined for high temporal resolution. We introduce Looping Kooshball (LKB), a complementary LS trajectory that extends through all three spatial dimensions within each shot. LKB is designed to improve volumetric k-space coverage while preserving the echo-formation and coherence-crushing properties of LS. We compare LKB with conventional LS using point-spread-function analysis, in-bore acoustic measurements, structural phantom imaging, and preliminary visual-motor fMRI experiments. We evaluate whether LKB reduces undersampling artifacts and improves temporal stability and functional-activation detection without sacrificing the near-silent operation of LS.

AI.tldr: 提出近静音fMRI轨迹Looping Kooshball (LKB)，在单次激发内贯穿三维k空间，相比常规Looping Star改善k空间覆盖并减少欠采样伪影。
AI.motivation: 常规梯度回波EPI声压级高，扫描噪声引发焦虑、头动和听觉响应，干扰任务态与静息态fMRI；近静音的Looping Star (LS)在时间分辨率高、合并激发数少时，因平面轨迹在k空间中心附近相交、外周稀疏非均匀，覆盖效率不足。
AI.method: 设计LKB互补LS轨迹，使每次读出的编码轨迹在三维空间内延伸，同时保留LS的回波形成与相干性散相（coherence crushing）特性；通过点扩散函数分析、磁体腔内声学测量、结构模体成像及初步视觉-运动fMRI实验，与常规LS对比。
AI.result: 摘要未报告定量结果；评估指标包括欠采样伪影程度、时间稳定性及功能激活检测性能，并检验是否保持LS的近静音特性。
AI.conclusion: LKB有望在不牺牲近静音操作的前提下改善体积k空间覆盖、降低欠采样伪影并提升fMRI时间稳定性与激活检测能力；具体结论有待实验数据支持。

title: Neutron spectrometry of (p,n) based neutron fields at the University of Helsinki using the NCT-WES single-moderator directional spectrometer
summary: A tunable-energy neutron beam produced with up to 1 $μ$A / 10 MeV proton beam on a solid LiF target is available at the Department of Physics of the University of Helsinki for neutron metrology and research applications. This work presents the experimental characterisation of the neutron beams produced at the Helsinki Accelerator Laboratory, and the validation of the \texttt{MCNP6} and \texttt{GEANT4} radiation transport codes for simulating these neutron beams. The neutron spectra produced in the forward direction from 1960, 2040, and 2310 keV protons were measured using the NCT-WES single-moderator directional spectrometer. NCT-WES (Neutron Capture Therapy Wide Energy Spectrometer) is a recently developed single-moderator neutron spectrometer with a sharply directional response, and it is a very convenient instrument to characterise neutron facilities, as it determines the whole spectrum in a single exposure, and has a low sensitivity to room-scattering. The neutron fluence was also determined with the Berthold LB 6411 neutron monitor. The data acquired with NCT-WES were unfolded using the FRUIT unfolding code, starting from guess spectra obtained from \texttt{GEANT4} or \texttt{MCNP6} simulations. The unfolding analysis showed that both transport codes produced plausible spectra, \texttt{MCNP6} being more accurate for the 1960 and 2040 keV irradiations and \texttt{GEANT4} for 2310 keV. The measured values of energy-integrated neutron fluence agree satisfactorily with simulations as well as preliminary measurements with the LB 6411 neutron monitor.

AI.tldr: 在赫尔辛基大学加速器实验室的固态LiF靶上，用最高1 μA/10 MeV质子束产生可调能量中子束，利用NCT-WES单慢化体定向谱仪测量1960、2040、2310 keV质子对应的前向中子能谱，并结合FRUIT解谱与MCNP6/GEANT4模拟进行实验表征与代码验证。
AI.motivation: 赫尔辛基大学物理系已具备基于LiF靶的质子诱发可调能量中子束，可用于中子计量与研究，但该中子场的能谱特性尚缺乏系统的实验表征；同时MCNP6与GEANT4对该类中子束的模拟能力尚未验证。
AI.method: 用NCT-WES（中子俘获治疗宽能谱谱仪）单慢化体定向谱仪测量1960/2040/2310 keV质子照射下前向中子谱，并用Berthold LB 6411中子监测仪测定中子注量；以GEANT4或MCNP6模拟谱作为初始猜测谱，用FRUIT解谱代码处理NCT-WES数据；将解谱结果、注量测量值与两套蒙卡模拟进行对比。
AI.result: NCT-WES具有强定向响应、单次照射即可给出全谱且对房间散射不敏感，适合中子设施表征。解谱结果显示MCNP6与GEANT4均能给出合理谱形，其中1960与2040 keV照射下MCNP6更准确，2310 keV下GEANT4更准确；能量积分注量与模拟及LB 6411初步测量结果吻合良好。
AI.conclusion: NCT-WES配合FRUIT解谱可有效表征LiF靶质子诱发中子束；MCNP6与GEANT4模拟对该中子场总体可靠，但精度依赖入射质子能量，二者可互为补充；注量测量与模拟的一致性验证了该中子束用于计量与研究的可行性。

title: Engineering Canalized Near-Field Radiative Heat Transfer between Fixed Nanoparticles with Twisted $α$-MoO$_3$ Trilayers
summary: Canalized phonon polaritons in twisted van der Waals crystals offer a route to control nanoscale thermal energy flow. Building on the established twisted $α$-MoO$_3$ trilayer platform, we examine how internal twist angles modify near-field radiative heat transfer (NFRHT) between a prescribed nanoparticle pair while both the nanoparticle axis and the bottom-layer crystallographic orientation remain fixed. Under this constraint and at equal total $α$-MoO$_3$ thickness, the optimized trilayer reaches 2.84 times the bilayer maximum radiative power, while its mean power over the sampled internal twist configurations is 1.51 times the bilayer value. The second internal twist coordinate also enlarges the set of configurations supporting strong transfer, with local angular tolerance when either internal angle is varied separately. Momentum-space Green-tensor diagnostics and real-space energy-density maps associate the enhancement with stronger receiver-directed scattering and improved channel alignment. Selected trilayer configurations retain enhanced coupling across the sampled family of nanoparticle resonances and at long distances. These results quantify the additional internal configurational freedom available for engineering radiative heat transfer under a fixed laboratory-frame geometry.

AI.tldr: 在固定纳米颗粒轴与底层晶向的条件下，研究扭转α-MoO₃三层结构的内部扭转角对近场辐射传热的影响；优化构型达到双层最大辐射功率的2.84倍。
AI.motivation: 扭转范德华晶体中的通道化声子极化激元可用于调控纳米尺度热流，但内部扭转角这一额外自由度在固定实验室坐标系几何下对近场辐射传热（NFRHT）的作用尚需量化。
AI.method: 以已建立的扭转α-MoO₃三层平台为对象，在纳米颗粒对轴线与底层晶向固定、总厚度相同的约束下扫描内部扭转角；用动量空间格林张量诊断与实空间能量密度图分析机制。
AI.result: 优化三层结构的最大辐射功率为双层最大值的2.84倍，内部扭转构型平均功率为双层的1.51倍；第二个内部扭转坐标扩大了强传热构型集合，单一角度变化时存在局部角度容差；增强源于更强的朝向接收端散射与更好的通道对准，且在多种颗粒共振和长距离下仍保持增强。
AI.conclusion: 内部扭转构型自由度可在固定外部几何下额外调控近场辐射传热，为纳米尺度热流工程提供新的设计维度。

title: Nonreciprocal coupling enables tunable exceptional-point response in non-Hermitian circuits
summary: Exceptional points (EPs) exhibit characteristic square-root spectral responses to weak perturbations, with response magnitudes governed by configuration-dependent prefactors that are often relatively small. Modulating these prefactor while preserving the exceptional characteristics offers an additional degrees of freedom for engineering non-Hermitian sensing responses. Here, we report a nonreciprocal non-Hermitian circuit system with gyrator-meditated coupling that supports a continuous family of EP configurations. Unlike reciprocal coupling, which typically yields a unique EP configuration for balanced gain and loss, nonreciprocal coupling allows the directional forward and backward coupling strengths to be varied while maintaining their product and thus preserving the EP condition and yielding a library of EPs. This additional freedom enables continuous control of the frequency-splitting magnitude without modifying the square-root characteristic dependence on absolute perturbation strength. We show that the spectral splitting induced by a given absolute resistance perturbation can be enhanced by appropriately adjusting the coupling asymmetry. Theoretical predictions, circuit simulations, and experimental reflection-spectrum measurements consistently confirms this tunable response. Our results establish nonreciprocal coupling as an alternative approach for engineering and enhancing EP-induced perturbative responses without changing their characteristic branch-point scaling.

AI.tldr: 提出一种采用回转器介导耦合的非互易非厄米电路系统，可在保持EP条件（耦合强度乘积不变）的前提下连续调节前向/后向耦合不对称度，从而连续调控弱扰动下的本征频率分裂幅度，实现EP传感响应的可调与增强。
AI.motivation: EP对弱扰动呈平方根响应，但其响应幅度由构型依赖的前因子决定，而传统互易耦合在平衡增益/损耗下仅给出唯一EP构型，前因子往往较小。因此希望在不破坏EP奇异特性的前提下增加调控自由度，以工程化并增强EP传感响应。
AI.method: 构建含回转器介导耦合的非互易非厄米电路：非互易耦合允许在保持前向与后向耦合强度乘积不变（即维持EP条件）的同时改变二者不对称度，从而获得一族连续EP构型；通过调节耦合不对称度控制给定绝对电阻扰动所引起的频率分裂。用理论推导、电路仿真与反射谱实验进行验证。
AI.result: 非互易耦合给出连续的EP构型族，可在保持对绝对扰动强度的平方根标度关系不变的同时连续调节频率分裂幅度；适当调整耦合不对称度可增强给定电阻扰动下的谱分裂。理论预测、电路仿真与实验反射谱测量三者一致。
AI.conclusion: 非互易耦合为工程化与增强EP诱导的微扰响应提供了新途径，且不改变其分支点标度特性；该机制可推广用于EP传感与外场探测的灵敏度优化。

title: From the Superderivative to a Relative-Gradient Edge Operator
summary: First-derivative edge detectors such as Sobel, Prewitt, Roberts and Scharr measure absolute grey-level differences. We revisit the log-gradient magnitude, a relative-gradient edge operator, and motivate it by analogy with the superderivative, a multiplicative derivative in which the independent variable is perturbed multiplicatively rather than additively. In one and two dimensions the logarithm of the superderivative is a radial logarithmic derivative; its local, origin-free, isotropic analogue is the magnitude of the logarithmic gradient. The resulting operator measures relative rather than absolute change, giving an edge-strength map that is invariant under global intensity rescaling. We present the theory, show how the operator can be implemented in two steps---a classical gradient kernel plus a pointwise division---and compare it with standard first-derivative filters on synthetic images with ground-truth edges and on the official BSDS500 benchmark. We also study a parametric family that interpolates between the absolute gradient and the log-gradient; empirically, the best members are small intermediate exponents, which edge the classical kernels by a small but statistically detectable margin in the per-image metric and, with the same Gaussian smoothing as the single-$σ$ Canny, match it in ODS and lead it in OIS and AP, while the tuned Canny remains ahead in ODS. The single-threshold margin over the kernels does not replicate on the held-out test split, and the fully relative endpoint is never the best member, its ranking depending on the edge-map normalisation. The contribution is the construction and the invariance it buys, not a new state of the art.

AI.tldr: 本文将经典一阶边缘检测算子重释为绝对灰度差测量，提出以"超导数"类比导出的对数梯度幅值（log-gradient magnitude）作为相对梯度边缘算子，并给出理论、实现（梯度核＋逐点除法）与在合成图及BSDS500上的实验对比，定位为"构造与尺度不变性"贡献而非SOTA。
AI.motivation: Sobel、Prewitt、Roberts、Scharr等一阶导数边缘检测器度量的是绝对灰度级差，因此在全局强度缩放（如曝光、增益变化）下边缘强度图不稳定。作者希望引入一种度量相对变化的算子，使边缘强度图在全局强度重缩放（乘性扰动）下保持不变，并以乘法导数（超导数）的数学类比为其提供原理性动机。
AI.method: 沿"超导数（独立变量作乘性扰动）→其对数即径向对数导数→局部、无原点、各向同性类比即对数梯度幅值"的路径构造算子；该算子可由两步实现：经典梯度核＋逐点（除法形式的）归一化。同时构造参数族，在绝对梯度与对数梯度之间插值（指数参数）。评测：合成图像（含真值边缘）与官方BSDS500基准，指标为per-image metric、ODS/OIS/AP；与标准一阶导数滤波器和单σ Canny（相同高斯平滑）对比，并做留出测试集验证与边缘图归一化敏感性分析。
AI.result: 参数族中最优成员为小的中间指数：在per-image metric上以虽小但统计可检测的优势略胜经典核；在与单σ Canny相同高斯平滑下，ODS持平、OIS与AP领先；但经调参的Canny在ODS上仍更优。相对核的单阈值优势在留出测试集上不可复现；完全相对的端点（纯对数梯度）从不是最优成员，其排名依赖边缘图归一化方式。
AI.conclusion: 本文的主要贡献在于对数梯度（相对梯度）边缘算子的构造及其带来的全局强度缩放不变性，而非新的最优性能。绝对梯度与对数梯度之间的插值族显示最优解偏向弱相对性（小指数），纯相对形式受归一化影响大且未带来增益；相对核相对经典核的优势在训练划分上可检测但泛化有限。

title: {DEMAND}: {A}n organic glass scintillator array for direct measurements of $(α,n)$ and $(p,n)$ reactions in inverse kinematics
comment: Accepted for publication in Nucl. Instrum. and Meth. in Phys. Res. A
summary: We have developed an array of up to 20 organic glass scintillator detectors, each consisting of a $3~\mathrm{cm}\times3~\mathrm{cm}\times3~\mathrm{cm}$ scintillator cube coupled to a photomultiplier tube. Sensitive to neutrons from a few hundred keV to several tens of MeV, the array was designed for use with recoil separators in inverse-kinematics measurements of astrophysical $(α,n)$ and $(p,n)$ reactions. It provides a prompt start signal for identifying recoil-neutron coincidences from the recoil time of flight. We characterize eight detectors used in an inverse-kinematics measurement of $^{22}\mathrm{Ne}(α,n)^{25}\mathrm{Mg}$, using source and in-beam data. From the widths of $γ$-ray Compton-edge peaks at 311, 341, 477, and 1062 keVee, we find an energy resolution described by $\mathrm{FWHM}(E)/E=\sqrt{A^2/E+B^2/E^2+C^2}$, with $A=0.00(7)$, $B=0.0618(54)$, and $C=0.135(5)$. The time-difference spectrum of nearest-neighbor $γ$-$γ$ coincidences from a $^{22}\mathrm{Na}$ source (250--600 keVee) gives a FWHM coincidence timing resolution of $910(40)$ ps, corresponding to a single-detector resolution of $640(30)$ ps. Mixed neutron-$γ$ fields from the in-beam reaction and a $^{241}\mathrm{AmBe}$ source show pulse-shape discrimination with an $n$-$γ$ figure of merit $>1$ down to about 100 keVee. Below 100 keVee, the total neutron yield can still be extracted using two-Gaussian fits to energy-gated pulse-shape discrimination spectra. Monte Carlo simulations of the present $^{22}\mathrm{Ne}(α,n)^{25}\mathrm{Mg}$ measurement give a neutron singles detection efficiency of $1.56(45)%$, with uncertainty dominated by systematic effects in the simulation inputs.

AI.tldr: 研制了最多20个（3×3×3 cm³闪烁体+PMT）有机玻璃闪烁体探测器阵列，用于反运动学下天体物理(α,n)/(p,n)反应的反冲-中子符合测量；用源和在束数据表征了其中8个探测器，给出能量分辨率、时间分辨率、PSD性能及探测效率。

title: Maxwell's equations are universal for sparse linear algebra
comment: 102 pages (16 pages main text, 86 pages Supplementary Information), 6 figures, 2 tables
summary: Optical and wave-based analog computing has re-emerged as a route to accelerating linear algebra, with metamaterials and photonic circuits shown to invert matrices and solve integral equations. However, it has remained unclear which problems such passive structures can represent, and at what cost, once encoding, precision, conditioning and readout are accounted for. Here, we show that every polynomially conditioned sparse linear system can be compiled into a three-dimensional dielectric -- a cavity filled with lossless, isotropic material of bounded permittivity -- whose time-harmonic response encodes its solution. For $m$ nonzero coefficients, the volume of the structure and the cost of writing it down and reading out the answer scale as $\tilde O(m^{3/2})$, coefficients require only $O(\log m)$ bits, and every field that approximately satisfies Maxwell's equations decodes to an approximate solution. We prove the construction for the continuum equations and give a computer-assisted version for the Yee discretization underlying finite-difference solvers. Read in reverse, it implies that electromagnetic simulation is, up to this overhead, as hard as general sparse linear algebra: a sufficiently fast general-purpose Maxwell solver would yield a faster sparse linear solver.

AI.tldr: 该论文证明任意多项式条件数的稀疏线性系统都可被编译为三维无损各向同性介质腔体，其时谐响应即编码解；存在性、复杂度（体积与读写代价 Õ(m^{3/2})、系数 O(log m) 比特）与鲁棒性均被严格证明，并给出 Maxwell 求解与稀疏线性代数在开销意义下的等价性。
AI.motivation: 光学与波模拟计算被广泛用于加速线性代数（超材料/光子电路可求逆矩阵、解积分方程），但被动结构究竟能表示哪些问题、在计入编码、精度、条件数与读出后代价如何，此前并不清楚。
AI.method: 将多项式条件数稀疏线性系统编译为三维介电腔体（无损、各向同性、有限介电常数），利用时谐响应编码解；在连续 Maxwell 方程上给出构造性证明，并针对有限差分所用的 Yee 离散化给出计算机辅助验证版本；分析体积、系数比特数、读写复杂度，并论证满足 Maxwell 方程的近似场可解码为近似解。
AI.result: 对 m 个非零系数，结构体积与写入/读出代价为 Õ(m^{3/2})，每个系数仅需 O(log m) 比特；任何近似满足 Maxwell 方程的场均可解码出近似解，即构造对扰动具有鲁棒性。反向解读得出：足够快的通用 Maxwell 求解器将给出更快的稀疏线性求解器。
AI.conclusion: 被动波动物理结构在多项式开销下可表示全部多项式条件数稀疏线性系统，划定了波模拟计算的表示能力与代价边界；同时表明电磁仿真在上述开销意义下与一般稀疏线性代数同等困难，为波计算与数值线性代数建立了双向复杂性联系。

title: Scattering-force-driven light-sheet fluorescence microscopy for scan-free three-dimensional imaging
summary: Optical manipulation offers a powerful non-contact approach to precise positioning, directional transport and three-dimensional (3D) imaging of microscale objects. However, positional fluctuations during optical confinement introduce spatial sampling errors that compromise imaging quality and acquisition speed. Here, we demonstrate a scattering-force-driven optical manipulation imaging method that replaces the stepwise scanning of conventional optical trapping with continuous directional transport of microparticles. An axial scattering force generated by a low-numerical-aperture focused beam propels microparticles through a light sheet, while their positions and fluorescence signals are simultaneously recorded to establish direct spatial correspondence between particle motion and tomographic images. Experiments demonstrate that this approach reduces the effects of positional fluctuations on 3D imaging, achieving an axial sampling interval of 0.1 μm and an imaging rate of 250 Hz. The method also enables effective imaging of samples with diverse structural features while reducing optical power requirements by 70%. By combining robust spatial sampling, high-speed acquisition and reduced photodamage, this approach offers a promising route to rapid 3D imaging, dynamic observation and microscale spatial analysis of microparticles and biological specimens.

AI.tldr: 提出散射力驱动的光操控成像方法，用低数值孔径光束的轴向散射力连续输运微粒穿过光片，实现0.1 μm轴向采样间隔和250 Hz成像速率。
AI.motivation: 传统光镊逐步扫描过程中微粒位置的涨落会引入空间采样误差，损害成像质量与采集速度。
AI.method: 以低数值孔径聚焦光束产生的轴向散射力推动微粒穿过光片，同时记录微粒位置与荧光信号，建立粒子运动与层析图像之间的直接空间对应，取代逐步扫描。
AI.result: 轴向采样间隔0.1 μm，成像速率250 Hz；降低位置涨落对三维成像的影响，可成像多种结构特征样品，光功率需求降低70%。
AI.conclusion: 该方法兼具稳健空间采样、高速采集与低光损伤，为微粒和生物样本的快速三维成像、动态观测及微尺度空间分析提供了可行途径。

title: Guidance-Coupled Nullspace Drifting for One-Step Medical Image Reconstruction
summary: Generative reconstruction can recover high-quality images from undersampled acquisitions, but state-of-the-art generative priors commonly rely on iterative sampling. Reducing the number of iterations lowers inference cost but also removes opportunities for progressive distributional refinement, making it difficult to retain image realism without sacrificing reconstruction fidelity. Drift modeling offers an alternative by shifting progressive refinement to training, thereby enabling one-step sampling without an iterative inference trajectory. Existing drifting methods, however, do not account for the imaging operator when modeling distributional drift. We propose DriftRecon, a generative method for one-step medical image reconstruction that performs drifting directly in the nullspace of the imaging operator. DriftRecon uses nullspace-restricted noise to construct training samples and a multiscale generator that incorporates measurement conditioning across resolution levels, with its generated component projected onto the operator nullspace. To control the fidelity--realism trade-off at inference, a conditional guidance parameter continuously steers the same generator between measurement-conditioned and unconditional generation. We derive a guidance-dependent similarity-kernel temperature schedule that preserves the guidance-weighted mass receiving strengthened supervision, thereby progressively localizing drift interactions as guidance increases to limit the associated loss of reconstruction fidelity. Experiments in sparse-view CT and accelerated MRI reconstruction show that DriftRecon outperforms established generative reconstruction methods and recent drifting models while producing reconstructions in a single forward pass.

AI.tldr: DriftRecon将漂移建模(drift modeling)直接移到成像算子的零空间中进行，实现医学图像的单步(one-step)生成式重建，在稀疏视图CT与加速MRI上优于现有生成式重建方法与漂移模型。
AI.motivation: 生成式重建虽能从欠采样数据恢复高质量图像，但主流生成先验依赖迭代采样；减少迭代次数会牺牲逐步分布精化能力，难以兼顾真实感与保真度。漂移建模把渐进精化移到训练阶段，可单步采样，但现有漂移方法在建模分布漂移时未考虑成像算子。
AI.method: 1) 在成像算子零空间内执行漂移，用零空间受限噪声构造训练样本；2) 设计多尺度生成器，在各分辨率层级引入测量条件，并将生成分量投影到算子零空间；3) 推理时用条件引导参数在"测量条件生成"与"无条件生成"之间连续调节保真—真实权衡；4) 推导与引导强度相关的相似核温度调度，保持被强化监督的引导加权质量不变，随引导增强逐步局部化漂移交互以抑制保真度损失。
AI.result: 在稀疏视图CT和加速MRI重建实验中，DriftRecon优于既有生成式重建方法与近期漂移模型，且仅需一次前向传播即可完成重建。
AI.conclusion: 将漂移生成约束在成像算子零空间，并结合条件引导与温度调度，可在单步推理下有效平衡重建保真度与图像真实感，为快速生成式医学图像重建提供可行方案。

title: Optical Calibration of a Frequency-Domain-Multiplexed X-Ray TES Microcalorimeter Array via Photon-Number-Resolved Statistics
summary: Transition-edge sensor (TES) microcalorimeters for future X-ray space observatories require accurate low-energy calibration, a regime where conventional X-ray sources are limited by intrinsic linewidth, count rate, or experimental complexity. In this work, we investigate fibercoupled optical photons as a compact calibration tool for an Athena-like TES array. Optical pulses at 405 nm were generated with an acousto-optic modulator and delivered through an optical fiber onto a selected TES pixel inside a dilution refrigerator, via a dedicated cryogenic alignment interface. Externally triggered pulses were processed with an optimal-filter pipeline, including baseline subtraction, drift correction, and multi-Gaussian reconstruction of the pulse-height spectrum. The reconstructed spectra show resolved photon-number peaks consistent with the Poissonian statistics expected from an attenuated coherent source, reaching equivalent energies above 400 eV with a mean photon number exceeding 100 per pulse. The detector response was further tested for linearity by comparing the measured photon-number distributions against those predicted from the independently calibrated number of photons sent to the detector and a single, globally estimated detection efficiency, confirming Poissonian, linear behaviour across nearly two orders of magnitude in photon number. These results demonstrate that fiber-delivered optical photons can probe the few-eV to sub-keV response of Athena-like TES microcalorimeters, offering a practical and extensible framework for future low-energy calibration studies.

AI.tldr: 利用光纤耦合的405 nm光子在稀释制冷机内对类Athena TES微热量计进行低能标定，重构出分辨的光子数峰并验证了近乎两个数量级范围内的泊松线性响应，等效能量超400 eV、单脉冲平均光子数超100。
