title: Volumetric Nanophotonics for Enhanced Scintillation and Remote Light Outcoupling
comment: 11 pages, 4 figures in main text; 30 pages, 11 figures, 4 tables in Supplementary Materials
summary: Nanophotonic patterning is a promising approach to enhancing light extraction in scintillator materials, with the potential to improve performance in applications such as medical imaging and particle detection. While 2D surface patterns have been successful in improving scintillator performance, the true potential of nanophotonic patterning lies in the bulk, where photons are emitted, transported, and absorbed. Here, we experimentally demonstrate the enhancement and control of scintillation using 2.5D volumetric nanophotonic patterns. Using a direct femtosecond laser writing approach, we nanofabricate square lattices of air holes into the bulk of inorganic scintillators (YAG:Ce and YAG:Yb), achieving nearly subwavelength periods compared to the peak emission wavelength and depths up to hundreds of microns, which fill a large fraction of the full thickness of the bulk. Under high-energy excitation, the patterns appear up to ~3.5$\times$ brighter and demonstrate emission enhancement trends consistent with well-established nanophotonic scaling laws. We also report a novel functionality we call "remote outcoupling," in which the nanophotonic patterns emit light that is generated in another region of the scintillator, without being directly excited themselves. Our monolithic nanofabrication approach extends nanophotonic scintillators into the bulk, which is an important step towards total control over scintillation using photonic design.

AI.tldr: 该工作利用飞秒激光直写在本体内部制备2.5D体纳米光子空气孔方阵，实验上显著增强并调控闪烁发光，并首次报道"远程出光"功能。
AI.motivation: 现有纳米光子图案多局限于2D表面，而闪烁光子的发射、输运与吸收主要发生在本体内部，表面图案难以实现全面调控，因此需将纳米光子结构引入材料本体。
AI.method: 采用飞秒激光直写，在YAG:Ce与YAG:Yb无机闪烁体本体内部制备近亚波长周期（相对发射峰波长）、深度可达数百微米的空气孔方阵（2.5D体图案），并在高能激发下测量其发光特性。
AI.result: 图案区域亮度提升最高约3.5倍，增强趋势与既有纳米光子缩放规律一致；并观察到"远程出光"效应——图案本身未被直接激发，却能输出在闪烁体其他区域产生的光。
AI.conclusion: 该单片集成纳米制备方法将纳米光子闪烁体拓展至体材料，是实现光子设计对闪烁过程完全调控的重要一步。

title: Temporal equivalent of the Sommerfeld half-plane problem
summary: Sommerfeld's half-plane problem, describing diffraction of a monochromatic wave by a semi-infinite perfectly electric conducting (PEC) infinitesimally thin plate, is one of the cornerstones of classical electromagnetic scattering theory. Here we study its temporal analogue: a semi-infinite medium with the Drude dispersion, adjacent to air, whose plasma frequency is rapidly reduced to zero, thus turning it into air, while a monochromatic wave with frequency below the plasma frequency illuminates it under normal incidence. Unlike the PEC plate, the Drude medium supports evanescent penetration of the field prior to its temporal transition; the temporal interface here acts as the analogue of the sharp spatial boundary in the Sommerfeld problem, but now separates two time intervals rather than two spatial half-planes. We show that this transition forces the standing wave in air in front of the Drude medium and the evanescent fields inside it to propagate in both directions, while preserving their spatial field structure. In addition, we observe the excitation of additional electric and magnetic field waves generated by a "DC" current density associated with the time interface. Our findings offer insight into the electromagnetic wave behavior at temporal transitions in dispersive media and may find applications in time- and space-time metamaterials

AI.tldr: 该文研究Sommerfeld半平面问题的**时间类比**：半无限Drude色散介质（邻接空气）的等离子体频率在时间上瞬时降为零而变为空气，频率低于等离子体频率的单色波正入射。结果表明时间界面迫使空气中驻波与介质内倏逝场沿双向传播但保持空间场结构，并激发由与时间界面相关的"DC"电流密度产生的附加电磁波。
AI.motivation: 经典Sommerfeld半平面问题刻画PEC半无限薄板对单色波的衍射，是电磁散射理论的基石，但其对应的是**空间**边界的突变。时间超材料/时变介质研究兴起后，缺乏与Sommerfeld问题严格对应的**时间界面**版本分析；且现有时间界面研究多集中于均匀非色散介质，未考虑色散介质在转变前已存在倏逝穿透的情形。因此作者希望建立"时间Sommerfeld问题"这一类比，厘清色散介质时间突变下的场演化规律。
AI.method: 1) 构造几何与物理设定：半无限Drude介质（介电函数含等离子体频率ω_p与碰撞/阻尼项）毗邻真空，正入射频率低于ω_p的单色波，故介质内场为倏逝（场穿透深度有限），空气中形成驻波。2) 实施时间突变：在t=0时刻将ω_p瞬时降为零，使Drude介质突变为空气，时间界面分隔两个时间区间而非两个空间半平面（与Sommerfeld问题的空间边界形成类比）。3) 求解初值问题：以突变时刻的场分布（空气中的驻波+介质内的倏逝场）为初始条件，借助傅里叶/拉普拉斯变换求解突变后的时域Maxwell方程，分析各频谱分量的传播方向与空间结构。4) 识别源项：推导时间界面处由于∂D/∂t不连续所等效产生的"DC"电流密度，并计算其辐射的附加电场与磁场波。
AI.result: (1) 时间突变使空气中原本的驻波与Drude介质内原本单向衰减的倏逝场全部转为**双向传播**，但各自的**空间场结构（空间分布形状）保持不变**；(2) 出现由时间界面处等效"DC"电流密度所激发的**附加电场波与磁场波**，构成对原有场的叠加贡献；(3) 结果与PEC板情形形成对比：PEC板不存在场的倏逝侵入，而Drude介质在时间转变前支持倏逝穿透，因此时间界面情形下的场分解与波型结构更为丰富。
AI.conclusion: 该工作给出了Sommerfeld半平面问题的时间对应版本，揭示了色散介质中时间界面对驻波与倏逝场传播方向的重塑机制以及"DC"电流密度的辐射作用，深化了对色散介质时间转变中电磁波行为的理解，并可能应用于时间超材料与时空超材料的设计。

title: Blind Video Denoising for Vocal Tract rtMRI using a Self-Supervised Ensemble
summary: Real-time magnetic resonance imaging of the vocal tract makes speech articulation directly observable, but the trade-off between temporal resolution and signal quality introduces substantial noise and obscures fine articulatory detail. Since clean references cannot be acquired for a moving vocal tract, supervised denoising approaches are not applicable in this setting. We propose a self-supervised denoising framework that combines spatiotemporal super-resolution learning with pseudo-supervision derived from a variance-stabilized non-local means filter. A dual-model fusion strategy balances noise suppression and preservation of high-frequency articulatory structure. Experiments on the USC-75 multi-speaker dataset under natural noise conditions show that the ensemble raises the signal-to-noise ratio by 11.9 dB on unseen subjects while attaining more high-frequency articulatory content in the frames. Among tuned implementations of anisotropic diffusion, block-matching filtering, non-local means and pre-smoothed non-local means, every configuration that achieves comparable noise suppression does so at the cost of high-frequency content or of structural fidelity. Under severe added Gaussian, Rayleigh and Rician noise, peak signal-to-noise ratio improves by 7.6 to 11.8 dB and structural similarity roughly triples. An ablation shows that the variance-stabilized pseudo-supervision is an essential element for denoising, and that the effect is attributable to the hard thresholding contained in the stabilization transform.

AI.tldr: 提出一种自监督去噪框架，将时空超分辨学习与由方差稳定化非局部均值滤波产生的伪监督相结合，并用双模型融合平衡抑噪与高频发音结构保留，在无干净参考的实时MRI声道图像上实现显著去噪。
AI.motivation: 实时MRI可直观观测声道发音，但时间分辨率与信号质量之间存在权衡，带来严重噪声并模糊精细发音细节；由于运动中的声道无法获取干净参考，监督式去噪方法不适用。
AI.method: 自监督去噪框架：结合时空超分辨学习与伪监督（pseudo-supervision），伪标签来自方差稳定化的非局部均值滤波（variance-stabilized non-local means）；采用双模型融合（dual-model ensemble）策略平衡噪声抑制与高频发音结构保留。
AI.result: 在USC-75多说话人数据集自然噪声条件下，集成方法在未见受试者上将信噪比提升11.9 dB，且帧中高频发音内容更多；对anisotropic diffusion、block-matching、非局部均值及预平滑非局部均值各调优实现中，凡达到可比抑噪水平者均以损失高频内容或结构保真度为代价；在强高斯、Rayleigh与Rician噪声下PSNR提升7.6–11.8 dB，SSIM约提升三倍。消融表明方差稳定化伪监督是去噪的必要要素，其作用归因于稳定化变换中的硬阈值（hard thresholding）。
AI.conclusion: 无干净参考条件下，基于方差稳定化伪监督的自监督时空超分辨去噪可有效抑制噪声并保留高频发音细节，显著优于传统滤波方法，其关键机制为稳定化变换中的硬阈值。

title: Unlimited-Range Absolute Distance Interferometry Outdoors via Tunable Synthetic and Pseudo-Supersynthetic Wavelengths: The TeleYAG-II Interferometer
comment: 23 pages, 5 figures, research data openly available under the following DOI: https://doi.org/10.7795/720.20261014
summary: Absolute distance interferometry requires an unlimited non-ambiguity range to be truly absolute. Tunable synthetic wavelength interferometry allows for the construction of pseudo-supersynthetic wavelengths using a limited number of optical sources and a standard interferometer setup. This approach facilitates the creation of a series of consecutively deployable synthetic wavelengths, ultimately combining macroscopic unambiguity with microscopic interferometric accuracy. We have implemented and demonstrated this concept in the TeleYAG-II interferometer, designed as an SI-traceable standard for the calibration of geodetic baselines. The system employs two Nd:YAG lasers as optical sources, with their frequency difference controlled by a versatile optical phase-locked loop. Specifically engineered for robustness in field conditions, the heterodyne interferometer was validated through an outdoor measurement campaign. The results demonstrate the efficacy of the method, achieving an expanded measurement uncertainty of 0.13 mm over a distance of 224 m without the need for auxiliary length measurements.

AI.tldr: 提出"伪超合成波长"可调谐合成波长干涉方案，用两束Nd:YAG激光与光锁相环构建连续可部署的合成波长链，在TeleYAG-II干涉仪上实现无需辅助测长的224 m户外绝对测距，扩展不确定度0.13 mm。
AI.motivation: 绝对距离干涉测量若要"真正绝对"，必须具备无限制的非模糊范围；同时需兼顾宏观无模糊与微观干涉精度，且系统要能在野外条件下保持稳健、可溯源至SI并用于大地测量基线标定。
AI.method: 采用两台Nd:YAG激光器作为光源，通过通用型光学锁相环控制二者频差，在标准干涉仪结构上以有限数量光源构建伪超合成波长，生成一系列可依次衔接（级联）的合成波长；将外差干涉仪工程化为野外稳健的TeleYAG-II系统，并开展户外测量试验验证。
AI.result: 户外测量试验验证了方法有效性：在224 m距离上无需任何辅助长度测量即完成绝对测距，扩展测量不确定度达0.13 mm（相对不确定度量级约6×10⁻⁷）。
AI.conclusion: 可调谐合成波长+伪超合成波长的级联策略可行，能以有限光源和标准干涉结构实现宏观无模糊与高精度兼得的真正绝对测距；TeleYAG-II可作为SI可溯源的大地测量基线标定标准器。

title: Spatial-Mode Selection for Local Mineral Absorption Spectroscopy
summary: Absorption-band depth measures the fractional decrease in mineral reflectance below its local continuum. Recovering this feature strength for a small mineral region supports quantitative comparisons between regions, but diffraction mixes its light with the surroundings. Conventional spectral fitting can separate mean contributions; it cannot remove background photon noise already recorded. We develop a quantum-inspired measurement framework that uses spatial-mode demultiplexing (SPADE) to retain the target absorption response while reducing background acceptance before detection. The framework connects finite mineral-region geometry and reference spectra to estimation precision. A loss-dependent design condition identifies when adding SPADE exposure improves on direct imaging (DI) under fixed-response Poisson measurements with unknown scene parameters. Joint inference from initial DI observations and both mode ports estimates target depth together with an unknown, spatially shared background spectrum. In equal-time simulations that include localization uncertainty, alignment time, calibration, and detector costs, this acquisition reduces depth root-mean-square error (RMSE) by 14\%--26\% across five absorption strengths relative to all-pixel DI with the same background freedom. These results use a supplied target feature shape and geometry, with target continuum slope fitted and curvature fixed. The analysis separates optical selectivity from parameter ambiguity and acquisition cost, providing a quantitative basis for spatial-mode receiver design in local mineral spectroscopy.

AI.tldr: 提出量子启发式空间模式解复用（SPADE）测量框架，在探测前抑制背景、保留目标矿物吸收响应，并给出估计精度的代价-条件分析。
AI.motivation: 小区域矿物吸收带深度（相对局部连续统的反射率下降比例）可用于区域间定量比较，但衍射将目标光与周围背景混合；常规光谱拟合只能分离平均贡献，无法去除已记录在案的光子噪声。
AI.method: 构建由有限矿物区域几何与参考光谱决定的SPADE测量框架；推导损耗相关的设计判据，用于判断在固定响应泊松测量、场景参数未知时SPADE是否优于直接成像（DI）；对初始DI观测与两个模式端口的联合推断，同时估计目标深度与空间共享的未知背景光谱。
AI.result: 在包含定位不确定度、对准时间、定标与探测器成本的等时仿真中，五种吸收强度下深度RMSE相对同等背景自由度的全像素DI降低14%–26%。
AI.conclusion: 该分析将光学选择性与参数模糊性、采集成本分离，为局部矿物光谱中的空间模式接收器设计提供定量依据；结果依赖给定的目标特征形状与几何，连续统斜率拟合、曲率固定。

title: Focal-Plane Extreme Adaptive Optics for Deep Super Resolution Imaging and Nanolithography
summary: Super resolution optical imaging and nanolithography enable nanoscale observation and fabrication, but high order, spatially varying phase and amplitude aberrations in optically heterogeneous media severely limit their performance at depth. Here we introduce focal-plane extreme adaptive optics (FP-ExAO), which moves beyond conventional phase conjugate correction by directly sensing and controlling the focal-plane complex field. This terminal field captures aberrations accumulated throughout the optical system. A state space formulation directly links deformable mirror commands to the focal field, avoiding explicit plane by plane Fourier optics modelling, while information theoretically optimal probing and closed-form control enable rapid field estimation and correction. Cascaded deformable mirrors further enable FP-ExAO to correct coupled phase-amplitude and spatially varying aberrations. In three-dimensional (3D) single molecule localization microscopy (SMLM), FP-ExAO enables imaging to 160 um depth in brain tissue and beyond 60 um in kidney tissue, while maintaining approximately 18 nm localization precision across a 75 um x 75 um corrected field, with a 16-fold larger field of view and more than tenfold faster correction than conventional AO methods. These capabilities meet the imaging requirements for 3D deep tissue optical connectome reconstruction and quantitative super resolution pathology. In stimulated emission depletion (STED) nanolithography, FP-ExAO reduces the minimum written linewidth from 251.1 nm without correction to 88.8 nm at a depth of 160 um in photoresist. FP-ExAO establishes a new adaptive optics paradigm for deep nanoscale optical readout and writing.

AI.tldr: 本文提出焦平面极端自适应光学（FP-ExAO），不在传统相位共轭层面校正，而是直接感知并控制焦平面复场，用状态空间模型联接变形镜指令与焦场，并借级联变形镜校正耦合的相位-振幅与空间变化像差。在3D单分子定位显微中实现脑组织160 μm、肾组织>60 μm深度成像，75 μm×75 μm视场内约18 nm定位精度，视场扩大16倍、校正速度快10倍以上；在STED纳米光刻中把160 μm深度处最小线宽从251.1 nm降至88.8 nm。
AI.motivation: 超分辨成像与纳米光刻需在深度处工作，但光学非均匀介质中存在高阶、空间变化的相位与振幅像差，严重限制其深层性能；传统相位共轭式AO难以应对这类像差。
AI.method: 提出FP-ExAO：直接传感与控制焦平面复场（终端场，涵盖全系统累积像差）；用状态空间表述直接建立变形镜指令与焦场的映射，避免逐面傅里叶光学建模；采用信息论最优探测与闭式控制实现快速场估计与校正；级联变形镜用于校正耦合的相位-振幅及空间变化像差。
AI.result: 3D SMLM：脑组织成像深度达160 μm、肾组织>60 μm，75 μm×75 μm校正视场内定位精度约18 nm，视场较传统AO扩大16倍、校正速度快10倍以上。STED纳米光刻：160 μm深光刻胶中最小线宽由251.1 nm（未校正）降至88.8 nm。
AI.conclusion: FP-ExAO满足3D深层组织光学连接组重建与定量超分辨病理的成像需求，并为深层纳米尺度光学读出与写入建立了新的自适应光学范式。

title: Label-free Monitoring of Nucleoid Dynamics of Bacteria for Drug Screening Using Holography
summary: We introduce holographic microscopy (HM) as a compact, low-cost, label-free, non-specific alternative to fluorescence microscopy (FM) for quantifying bacterial physiological responses during drug screening. Using the regularized inverse holographic volumetric reconstruction (RIHVR) framework, we extract phase maps from HM images and then invert the reconstructed phase to generate fluorescence-like contrast, in which bright inverted-phase regions correspond to bacterial nucleoid content captured by FM signals. We show that this relationship holds across multiple bacterial species, growth stages, drug treatments, and post-treatment time points, demonstrating that HM can consistently capture nucleoid associated structural information without fluorescent labeling. Because HM phase images contain both whole-cell refractive-index information and internal nucleoid-associated contrast, they enable simultaneous quantification of cell boundaries, cell length, nucleoid size, and nucleoid occupancy. These measurements allow drug-induced changes in bacterial morphology and nucleoid organization to be monitored over time. Unlike FM, which can suffer from photobleaching and may perturb live cells through phototoxicity, HM relies on refractive-index variations and maintains stable signal quality for long-term live-cell imaging. By linking label-free phase imaging to nucleoid-scale physiological readouts, this work establishes a path toward automated, high-throughput, and experimentally simpler bacterial drug-screening assays.

AI.tldr: 该文提出用全息显微(HM)替代荧光显微(FM)，在无标记条件下定量细菌核仁结构，实现药物筛选中的细菌生理响应监测。
AI.motivation: 荧光显微需外源标记，且存在光漂白和光毒性，难以长期活细胞成像；需要一种紧凑、低成本、无标记、非特异性的替代方案来量化药物处理下细菌的生理响应。
AI.method: 基于正则化逆全息体层重建(RIHVR)框架，从HM图像提取相位图，并对重建相位进行反相以获得类荧光对比，其中亮的反相区域对应FM所捕获的细菌核仁内容；在多菌种、不同生长阶段、多种药物处理及处理后期时间点上验证该对应关系。
AI.result: 反相相位与核仁相关对比在多条件下一致成立；因相位图同时包含全细胞折射率信息与内部核仁相关对比，可同时量化细胞边界、细胞长度、核仁尺寸与核仁占据率，并随时间追踪药物诱导的形态与核仁组织变化；相较FM，HM信号稳定、无光漂白与光毒性问题，适合长期活细胞成像。
AI.conclusion: 将无标记相位成像与核仁尺度生理读出相连接，为自动化、高通量、实验操作更简便的细菌药物筛选检测建立了路径。

title: Near-Field Engineering of Silica-Shelled Plasmonic Nanoparticles toward Enhanced Near-Infrared Fluorescence
summary: Near-infrared (NIR) fluorescent molecules often suffer from low quantum yields, limiting their applications in sensing and imaging. Their fluorescence can be enhanced by coupling with plasmonic nanoparticles exhibiting resonances in the same spectral region. However, this approach requires precise nanoscale control over the plasmonic near-field. Here, we combine scanning transmission electron microscopy with electron energy-loss spectroscopy (STEM-EELS) and boundary element electromagnetic simulations to engineer silica-coated anisotropic plasmonic nanoparticles. We synthesised three types of nanoparticles, gold nanorods (AuNRs), gold bipyramids (AuBPs), and silver nanorods (AgNRs) with tunable NIR plasmonic resonances. Silica serves as a dielectric spacer, enabling precise control over the distance between the nanoparticle surface and a potential molecular emitter. To assess their suitability for fluorophore attachment, we investigated the dependence of the electric near-field on silica shell thickness. High-resolution STEM-EELS mapping revealed that thin silica shells (4.4 nm for AuNRs and 3.1 nm for AuBPs) allow most of the near-field to extend beyond the dielectric layer. For AgNRs, a thicker shell of 7.0 nm was required to prevent oxidation while maintaining near-field accessibility. Electromagnetic simulations further evaluated the optimal shell thickness and the dependence of fluorescence enhancement on particle geometry, material, fluorophore internal quantum yield, and fluorophore-metal separation. Together, these results provide practical design guidelines for optimizing particle morphology and sub-10 nm silica shells in plasmonic nanostructures for fluorescence enhancement.

AI.tldr: 结合STEM-EELS与边界元电磁模拟，研究二氧化硅包覆的各向异性等离激元纳米颗粒（AuNRs、AuBPs、AgNRs），给出近场可及性与荧光增强的亚10 nm壳层设计准则。
AI.motivation: 近红外荧光分子量子产率低，限制其在传感与成像中的应用；借助同谱段等离激元共振的纳米颗粒可增强荧光，但需对等离激元近场实现精确纳米尺度调控。
AI.method: 制备三种可调近红外等离激元共振的二氧化硅包覆各向异性纳米颗粒（金纳米棒、金双锥、银纳米棒），硅层作为介电间隔层调控界面—发射体距离；结合STEM-EELS高分辨近场成像与边界元电磁模拟，分析近场随壳层厚度的衰减规律，并模拟荧光增强随颗粒几何、材料、荧光体本征量子产率及荧光体—金属间距的变化。
AI.result: STEM-EELS显示薄壳即可让大部分近场外溢：AuNRs为4.4 nm、AuBPs为3.1 nm；AgNRs需7.0 nm壳层以抑制氧化并保持近场可及性。模拟进一步给出最优壳层厚度及荧光增强对各参数的依赖关系。
AI.conclusion: 为等离激元纳米结构在荧光增强中的形貌优化与亚10 nm硅壳设计提供了实用指导准则。

title: Symmetry-governed nonlinear metasurface simultaneously enhances circular dichroism, helicity purity, and Q-factor
summary: Circularly polarized light underpins a broad range of chiroptical and spin-selective photonic technologies, yet extending resonant chirality to nonlinear harmonic emission remains challenging. Here, we experimentally demonstrate a symmetry-governed mechanism that maps the maximal linear chirality of high-Q degenerate resonances onto the polarization of the generated harmonic. Preserved rotational symmetry protects modal degeneracy and polarization-selection rules, while broken mirror symmetries enable a strong chiroptical response. The metasurface thereby filters the pump polarization and purifies the handedness of the nonlinear output, simultaneously achieving third-harmonic circular dichroism of -0.98, a degree of circular polarization of 0.83, and an effective nonlinear Q-factor of 140. Importantly, the nonlinear emission preserves its handedness even under spatially depolarized excitation, demonstrating robustness to variations in the incident polarization state. These results establish complementary symmetry preservation and breaking as a deterministic route for transferring resonant chirality from linear to nonlinear optical responses, providing a general design principle for nonlinear chiral photonics.

AI.tldr: 本文实验演示了一种由对称性支配的机制，将高Q简并共振的最大线性手性映射到谐波发射的偏振上，实现三次谐波圆二色性-0.98、圆偏振度0.83及有效非线性Q因子140。
AI.motivation: 圆偏振光在 chiral 光学与自旋选择性光子技术中应用广泛，但将共振手性拓展到非线性谐波发射仍具挑战。
AI.method: 利用超表面结构：保持旋转对称性以保护模式简并与偏振选择定则，同时破缺镜面对称性以获得强手性响应，从而过滤泵浦偏振并净化非线性输出的手性。
AI.result: 同时实现三次谐波圆二色性-0.98、圆偏振度0.83、有效非线性Q因子140；且在空间退偏振激发下非线性发射仍保持其手性。
AI.conclusion: "对称性互补地保持与破缺"可作为将共振手性从线性转移至非线性响应的确定性路径，为非线性手性光子学提供通用设计原则。

title: Non-Markovian quantum-emitter dynamics and bound-state formation in an Aubry--André--Harper photonic lattice
summary: In non-Markovian light-matter interactions, a spectrally structured bath can alter the evolution of a quantum emitter by modifying the vacuum fluctuations experienced by the emitter. This raises the question of how the localization transition and the associated multifractal critical modes induced by a quasiperiodic potential shape the emitter dynamics. We investigate this scenario in the single-excitation sector for a two-level quantum emitter coupled to an Aubry-André-Harper (AAH) photonic lattice. By externally tuning the strength of the quasiperiodic onsite modulation, the lattice is tuned from the extended to the localized regime through a critical point characterized by multifractal modes. Using modal analysis, we show that the quasiperiodic modulation reshapes the local density of states at the coupling site and thereby controls the effective spectral coupling between the emitter and the lattice. The transient dynamics depend strongly on the spatial and spectral overlap between the emitter and the lattice modes: extended modes below the critical modulation generally produce rapid depopulation, whereas critical and localized modes give rise to coherent back-action and persistent Rabi-like oscillations, with particularly pronounced behavior at the critical point. We further identify emitter-photon bound states whose formation is controlled by the quasiperiodic spectral structure of the bath and whose overlap with the initially excited state leads to partial long-time population trapping. These results establish a direct connection between quasiperiodic localization, non-Markovian dynamics, and emitter-photon bound-state formation.

AI.tldr: 研究二能级量子发射器耦合到AAH光子晶格时，准周期局域化与多重分形临界模如何调控发射器的非马尔可夫动力学。通过模态分析揭示：扩展模导致快速布居衰减，临界与局域模引发相干反馈和持续Rabi振荡，临界点效应最显著，并识别出由谱结构控制的发射器-光子束缚态导致的部分长时布居俘获。
AI.motivation: 在非马尔可夫光-物质相互作用中，具有谱结构的浴会通过改变真空涨落来影响量子发射器的演化。然而，由准周期势诱导的局域化转变及伴随的多重分形临界模如何塑造发射器动力学，这一问题尚未被系统研究，本文旨在填补这一空白。
AI.method: 在单激发子空间内，将二能级量子发射器耦合到Aubry-André-Harper（AAH）光子晶格。通过外部调节准周期在位调制的强度，使晶格从扩展区经多重分形临界点过渡到局域区。采用模态分析，考察准周期调制对耦合位点局域态密度（LDOS）的重塑以及由此控制的发射器-晶格有效谱耦合。
AI.result: 瞬态动力学强烈依赖发射器与晶格模在空间和谱上的重叠：临界调制以下的扩展模通常产生快速布居衰减；临界模与局域模则引起相干反馈与持续的类Rabi振荡，且在临界点行为尤为显著。此外识别出发射器-光子束缚态，其形成受浴的准周期谱结构控制，且其与初始激发态的重叠导致部分长时布居俘获。
AI.conclusion: 准周期局域化、非马尔可夫动力学与发射器-光子束缚态形成之间存在直接联系；AAH晶格的谱结构可作为调控发射器弛豫与相干动力学的有效手段。

title: Partially temporal coherent spatiotemporal Laguerre-Gaussian and its propagation dynamics
summary: Optical spatiotemporal vortices carrying transverse photonic orbital angular momentum have become an intense research topic in the recent study of structured light fields. Despite being mainly studied within the framework of fully coherent optical pulses, the complex topologies of the light field are also investigated with partially coherent light sources, offering an alternative pathway in applications. In this work, we theoretically and experimentally investigate partially temporally coherent spatiotemporal Laguerre-Gaussian (STLG) field with independently controllable radial and azimuthal indices. The spatiotemporal topological information, carried by the structured amplified spontaneous emission source, are well preserved in the presence of inherent instantaneous random temporal phase fluctuations. Under combined spatiotemporal astigmatism and group velocity dispersion, the partially temporally coherent STLG field can be converted into spatiotemporal Hermite-Gaussian (STHG) field. Both structures maintain their spatiotemporal characteristics after propagating through scattering media. Partially temporally coherent structured light fields may offer new insights into photonic topology and complex wave dynamics, with potential applications in high-fidelity optical communications and high-dimensional information processing in highly scattering environments.

AI.tldr: 该工作从理论与实验两方面研究部分时间相干时空拉盖尔-高斯（STLG）光场，其径向与角向指数可独立调控，并证明时空拓扑信息在随机瞬时相位涨落下得以保持，且可经时空像散与群速度色散转换为时空厄米-高斯（STHG）场。
AI.motivation: 携带横向光子轨道角动量的光学时空涡旋是结构光研究热点，但此前多在全相干脉冲框架下讨论；作者希望探索部分相干光源下复杂光场拓扑，寻找替代性技术路径，并考察其在散射环境中的稳健性。
AI.method: 采用结构化的放大自发辐射（ASE）光源作为部分时间相干载源；理论建模与实验相结合，构建径向、角向指数独立可控的部分时间相干STLG场；通过引入时空像散与群速度色散实现STLG→STHG的模式转换；并将两种结构光场经散射介质传输后进行表征。
AI.result: STLG场所携带的时空拓扑信息在固有的瞬时随机时间相位涨落下仍被良好保持；在时空像散与群速度色散共同作用下，部分时间相干STLG场可转换为STHG场；STLG与STHG两种结构经散射介质传播后均维持其时空特征。
AI.conclusion: 部分时间相干结构光场为光子拓扑与复杂波动力学研究提供了新视角，在高保真光通信及强散射环境中的高维信息处理方面具有潜在应用价值。

title: Integrated Circular Polarisation Beam Shaper Based on Tilted Waveguide Bragg Gratings
summary: Scalable quantum platforms require optical systems that deliver well-defined polarisation without relying on macroscopic bulk optics or manual alignment, motivating chip-integrated approaches capable of shaping both the spatial mode and the polarisation of the emitted field. By developing a full three-dimensional analytical model of the scattering process together with numerical simulations to design and evaluate the emitted field, we show that tilted waveguide Bragg gratings can act as integrated polarisation beam shapers. We find that scattering two co-propagating, orthogonally polarised pumps on a single grating is fundamentally limited: waveguide birefringence and the difference in scattering efficiency prevent full polarisation control. We overcome this with an orthogonal superimposed-grating architecture in which two gratings driven independently by two pumps propagating perpendicular to each other succeed in generating any desired polarisation output apart from directions in a narrow spatial region. The approach provides a scalable, chip-integrated route to polarisation-engineered light delivery for quantum technologies.

AI.tldr: 提出倾斜波导布拉格光栅作为集成偏振光束整形器，建立三维解析散射模型并结合数值模拟，发现单向双泵浦方案受波导双折射与散射效率差异限制，进而提出正交叠加光栅架构，可输出任意偏振态（除狭窄空间区域外），为量子技术提供可扩展的芯片集成偏振光源。
AI.motivation: 可扩展量子平台需要不依赖宏观体光学元件与人工对准的光学系统来提供确定偏振，因此需要能同时调控出射场空间模式与偏振的芯片集成方案。
AI.method: 建立散射过程的全三维解析模型，并配合数值模拟用于设计与评估出射场；分析倾斜波导布拉格光栅的偏振光束整形能力；比较共传播正交双泵浦单光栅方案与正交叠加光栅架构（两光栅由相互垂直传播的两泵浦独立驱动）。
AI.result: 共传播正交偏振双泵浦单光栅方案存在本质限制：波导双折射及散射效率差异导致无法实现完整偏振控制；正交叠加光栅架构可产生任意期望的偏振输出，仅排除狭窄空间区域内的方向。
AI.conclusion: 倾斜光栅可作为集成偏振光束整形器，正交叠加光栅架构突破了单光栅方案的固有限制，为量子技术提供了可扩展的芯片集成偏振工程化光传输路径。

title: Edge intelligence for distributed acoustic sensing with ultracompact neural networks
summary: Distributed acoustic sensing (DAS) transforms optical fibres into dense arrays of vibration sensors for continuous, long-range monitoring with high spatial resolution. Yet converting these large-scale measurements into actionable information with compact models that retain task performance remains challenging. Existing artificial-intelligence approaches are typically optimized for specific sensing environments and tasks, but their computational requirements can hinder deployment in compact, power-constrained field systems. Here, we introduce DAS-NanoNet, a framework that automatically constructs lightweight neural networks for different DAS scenarios and tasks, together with OmniDAS, an open benchmark spanning six representative environments. Using lightweight temporal operators tailored to DAS signals, an adaptive neural architecture search strategy derives a compact network for each scenario-task pairing. Across classification, localization, compression, and denoising tasks in diverse DAS applications, DAS-NanoNet consistently yields highly compact architectures. On a six-class dataset, it achieves 99.68% accuracy with only 1,391 trainable parameters, while delivering comparable or better performance with up to 18,098-fold fewer parameters than previously reported high-accuracy networks. Its compact architecture further enables edge deployment, achieving sub 9 $μ$s inference latency on the deployed hardware platform across different DAS applications. DAS-NanoNet provides a route towards edge intelligence for compact, low-power and real-time DAS systems through ultracompact networks tailored to individual sensing scenarios and tasks.

AI.tldr: 提出DAS-NanoNet框架，通过面向DAS信号的轻量时序算子与自适应神经架构搜索（NAS），为不同DAS场景-任务组合自动生成超紧凑网络，并发布覆盖六类环境的开放基准OmniDAS。
AI.motivation: DAS将光纤转化为高空间分辨率的密集振动传感阵列，但大规模测量难以转化为可用信息；现有AI方法针对特定环境与任务优化，计算开销大，难以部署于紧凑、功耗受限的现场系统。
AI.method: 1) 构建OmniDAS开放基准，涵盖六类代表性DAS环境；2) 设计适配DAS信号的轻量时序算子；3) 采用自适应神经架构搜索策略，为每个场景-任务组合自动推导紧凑网络；覆盖分类、定位、压缩、去噪四类任务。
AI.result: 所得架构高度紧凑：六分类数据集上仅1,391个可训练参数即达99.68%准确率；相比已报道的高精度网络，参数量最多减少18,098倍而性能相当或更优；在部署硬件平台上实现跨应用低于9 μs的推理延迟，支持边缘部署。
AI.conclusion: DAS-NanoNet为紧凑、低功耗、实时DAS系统提供了通向边缘智能的路径，通过针对个体传感场景与任务的超紧凑网络实现高效部署。

title: Ghosts in the nanomachine: dynamical slowing-down in the phase-space of nanomechanical strings
summary: The linear behavior of micro- and nanomechanical devices has been the topic of intense study over the past years. Their nonlinear behavior, on the other hand, continues to provide new and interesting dynamics. This work leverages a cavity opto-mechanical system whose very high sensitivity and low dissipation rate allows to capture the dynamics of fast transients that occur when strongly-driven nonlinear resonators relax to their equilibrium state. We experimentally study the ringdown dynamics of a nanomechanical Duffing resonator in both the time domain and in phase space. The resonator exhibits very different ringdown dynamics depending on whether it is subject to one or two tone driving. In the former case the ringdown follows a regular exponential decay, whereas the latter case shows exotic dynamics such as libration, slowing-down while scattering in phase-space, and ghost slowing-down. We demonstrate that this distinct difference can be attributed to the structure of the phase space itself. Surprisingly, we find that the energy in the resonator changes non-monotonously and that long delay between turning off the drive and the decay of the motion amplitude results in dynamical meta-states.

AI.tldr: 该工作利用高灵敏度、低耗散的腔光力系统，在时域和相空间中实验研究纳米机械Duffing谐振子的衰减（ringdown）动力学，揭示单音与双音驱动下截然不同的瞬态行为，并从相空间结构角度给出解释。
AI.motivation: 微纳机械器件的线性行为已被广泛研究，但其非线性动力学仍不断展现出新的有趣现象；借助腔光力系统的高灵敏度和低耗散率，可以捕捉强驱动非线性谐振子弛豫至平衡态过程中的快速瞬态动力学。
AI.method: 采用腔光力系统实验测量纳米机械Duffing谐振子的ringdown动力学，分别在时域与相空间中进行表征，并对比单音驱动与双音驱动两种情形。
AI.result: 单音驱动下ringdown表现为规则的指数衰减；双音驱动下则出现天平动（libration）、相空间中散射伴随的减速（slowing-down while scattering）以及"幽灵"减速（ghost slowing-down）等奇异动力学。研究表明这种差异源于相空间本身的结构；此外还发现谐振子能量呈非单调变化，且关断驱动到振幅衰减之间存在长延迟，形成动力学"亚稳态"（dynamical meta-states）。
AI.conclusion: 强驱动非线性谐振子的瞬态弛豫行为由相空间结构决定，双音驱动可诱导libration、ghost slowing-down及dynamical meta-states等非常规现象，能量非单调演化与长延迟衰减是其中的关键特征。

title: Multistable nematic liquid crystal pores as reconfigurable optical vortex metasurfaces
summary: Nematic liquid crystals confined in cylindrical pores adopt multiple stable director topologies --- radial, escaped, and arches --- each imprinting a distinct optical signature on transmitted circularly polarized light, with topological charge set by the projected director winding number, $\ell = 2m$. Using Landau--de Gennes and Jones-calculus modeling validated against micron-scale experiments, we show that this mechanism persists as the pore diameter shrinks toward the optical wavelength. However, full-wave Maxwell simulations of periodic sub-wavelength pore arrays reveal that the resulting vortex is a near-field phenomenon only: each topology imprints a distinguishable phase-singular signature --- differing in core multiplicity, core width, and ring amplitude --- directly below the pore array, but this signature does not survive propagation into the far field, where diffraction and inter-pore interference erase it within about one wavelength. Landau--de Gennes simulations further demonstrate that an applied electric field switches the pore between topologies, and hence between their near-field optical signatures. Because each topology is locally stable, sub-wavelength NLC pore arrays constitute an electrically reconfigurable, non-volatile platform for topology-encoded near-field optical readout, with potential application to optical labeling and anti-counterfeiting.

AI.tldr: 圆柱孔内向列相液晶的径向、逃逸与拱形三种指向矢拓扑，对透射圆偏振光产生拓扑电荷 \(\ell=2m\) 的光学烙印，并在孔阵列近场呈可区分的相位奇点特征；该特征不进入远场，但可由电场在拓扑间切换，构成可重构、非易失的近场拓扑编码读出平台。
AI.motivation: 受限液晶指向矢拓扑的光学可读性与尺寸缩减/实用化之间的矛盾：需明确亚波长孔径下拓扑光学印记是否仍成立，以及在周期阵列与远场传播中能否被分辨。
AI.method: Landau–de Gennes 连续介质建模 + Jones 矩阵偏振光学计算，并与微米尺度实验对照；进一步采用周期亚波长孔阵列的全波 Maxwell 仿真考察近场到远场的传播；并模拟外加电场对拓扑的切换。
AI.result: 光学角度动量/涡旋特征随孔径缩小至接近光波长仍保持；但涡旋仅为近场现象，三种拓扑在阵列正下方给出可区分相位奇点特征（核的多重度、核宽、环振幅不同），传播约一个波长内即因衍射与孔间干涉消失；电场可实现拓扑及其近场光学签名的可逆切换，且各拓扑局部稳定（非易失）。
AI.conclusion: 亚波长液晶孔阵列为电可重构、非易失的拓扑编码近场光学读出平台，适用于光学标记与防伪；但读出必须在近场完成，远场方案不可行。

title: Scale-free wave localization at topological multicriticality
summary: Spatial wave localization at boundaries is conventionally restricted to exponential decay. Here, we observe a scale-free boundary mode exhibiting anomalous polynomial decay, highlighted by strictly linear spatial envelopes, driven by topological multicriticality in acoustic metamaterials. We establish a universal geometric bulk-boundary correspondence rooted in singularity theory by mapping n-th order topological multicriticality onto Arnold An catastrophe. We prove that defectiveness in the spatial transfer matrix enforces a (n-1)-th power spatial decay of boundary modes. At a topological tri-critical point, the singularity of winding function manifests as an A2 fold catastrophe. This dictates a strictly linear spatial decay, marking a sharp departure from the conventional exponential scaling paradigm. Using acoustic metamaterial platforms tuned to a tricritical point, we experimentally demonstrate this linear decay envelope in 1D, and further generalize it to two-dimensional systems to realize scale-free corner modes with simultaneous linear decay along orthogonal directions. While existing critical topology frameworks rely on entanglement spectra to diagnose mode existence in gapless regimes, our work bridges catastrophe theory with topological matter at multicriticalities, advancing the field from abstract mode identification to deterministic real-space wavefunction engineering.

AI.tldr: 该文在声学超材料中实现并观测到由拓扑三临界点驱动的无标度边界模式，其空间包络呈严格线性衰减（而非指数衰减），并基于奇点理论（Arnold A_n 灾变）建立了普适的几何体—边对应关系，将 n 阶拓扑多临界性映射为 Arnold A_n 灾变，证明空间转移矩阵的亏欠性导致边界模按 (n-1) 次幂衰减。
AI.motivation: 传统的空间波局域化（边界模）被认为只能是指数衰减，且既有的临界拓扑框架主要依赖纠缠谱来"诊断"无能隙区间中模式是否存在，停留在抽象的"模式有无"判定层面，缺乏对真实空间波函数形态的确定性设计能力。作者希望突破指数标度范式，把灾变理论与多临界拓扑物质联系起来，实现从"模式识别"到"实空间波函数工程"的跃迁。
AI.method: 1) 基于奇点理论，将 n 阶拓扑多临界性映射到 Arnold A_n 灾变，建立普适的几何体—边对应（bulk-boundary correspondence）；2) 从理论上证明空间转移矩阵的亏欠性（defectiveness）强制边界模呈 (n-1) 次幂空间衰减；3) 特别地，在三临界点处绕数函数的奇点表现为 A2 折叠（fold）灾变，从而预言严格的线性衰减；4) 利用调谐至三临界点的声学超材料平台，在一维体系中实验验证线性衰减包络；5) 进一步推广到二维体系，实现沿两个正交方向同时线性衰减的无标度角态。
AI.result: 在一维声学超材料中实验观测到严格线性的空间衰减包络，证实了 A2 折叠灾变对应的 (n-1)=1 次幂衰减规律；在二维体系中成功实现无标度角模，其沿两个正交方向均呈线性衰减，突破了传统指数局域的范式。
AI.conclusion: 该工作将灾变理论与多临界拓扑物质相融合，提出并验证了由转移矩阵亏欠性决定的幂律边界局域化机制，把临界拓扑研究从基于纠缠谱的抽象模式判定推进到确定性的实空间波函数工程，为无标度局域态的可控设计提供了理论框架与实验平台。

title: Contact-free charge carrier density determination of doped sub-μm thin cubic GaN layers with terahertz time-domain spectroscopy
summary: As cubic GaN is a promising material for optoelectronic applications, its layers need to be precisely doped to realize the desired properties. While contact-based methods are established to measure the realized charge carrier density, contact-free techniques are more advantageous for this purpose. We show terahertz time-domain spectroscopy measurements of cubic GaN layers with thicknesses between 0.6 $μ$m and 2 $μ$m with doping densities in the range from $10^{18}$ cm$^{-3}$ to $10^{20}$ cm$^{-3}$. From these measurements, we determine the charge carrier densities and verify the results with time-of-flight secondary-ion mass spectrometry measurements. The results are in accordance with simulations of the doping ranges which the technique is expected to be sensitive in. In preparation for the terahertz time-domain spectroscopy measurements, we validated the layer thicknesses by Fourier-transform infrared spectroscopy measurements. With this, a wide range of doped cubic GaN samples can be addressed by optical methods. In the future, these techniques could allow for a fast and non-destructive characterization of GaN layers, right after or even during the growth process.

AI.tldr: 利用太赫兹时域光谱（THz-TDS）对0.6–2 μm厚、掺杂浓度10^18–10^20 cm^-3的立方GaN层进行非接触式载流子密度测量，并与ToF-SIMS结果及灵敏度模拟相符；测量前用FTIR验证层厚。
AI.motivation: 立方GaN是光电子应用的潜力材料，需精确控制掺杂；已有接触式方法可测载流子密度，但非接触、无损技术更具优势，尤其有望在生长后甚至生长过程中快速表征。
AI.method: 采用太赫兹时域光谱（THz-TDS）测量厚度0.6–2 μm、掺杂10^18–10^20 cm^-3的立方GaN层，提取载流子密度；以飞行时间二次离子质谱（ToF-SIMS）作为独立验证，并与该技术的掺杂灵敏度区间模拟对比；测量前用傅里叶变换红外光谱（FTIR）校验层厚。
AI.result: THz-TDS提取的载流子密度与ToF-SIMS结果一致，且符合技术灵敏度范围的模拟预期；FTIR成功验证层厚，表明宽掺杂范围的立方GaN样品均可由光学方法覆盖。
AI.conclusion: THz-TDS结合FTIR可实现立方GaN掺杂的快速、非接触、非破坏性表征，未来有望用于生长后乃至生长过程中的在线监测。

title: Nonlinear Jackiw-Rebbi exciton-polaritons at van der Waals topological interfaces

summary: Topological photonic structures provide a powerful means of confining and directing light through interface states formed between photonic phases with distinct topological properties. Van der Waals (vdW) materials offer complementary opportunities for nanophotonics: their optical properties can be selected from a wide family of layered crystals, while their atomically smooth surfaces and lack of lattice-matching constraints enable complex photonic heterostructures to be assembled layer by layer. This flexibility allows topological photonic confinement and strong excitonic coupling to be engineered separately within the same structure. Here, patterned low-loss dielectric hexagonal boron nitride (hBN) defines the photonic modes, while an encapsulated WSe2 monolayer provides the excitonic resonance that couples directly to the confined optical field. We use this approach to realise Jackiw-Rebbi exciton-polaritons in a one-dimensional hBN double-grating heterostructure. Strong coupling between the WSe2 exciton and a photonic Jackiw-Rebbi state localised at the interface between two topologically distinct gratings produces upper and lower Jackiw-Rebbi polariton branches. By varying the temperature from 4.7 to 300 K, we tune the exciton across the photonic bandgap and trace the evolution and anticrossing of these branches using angle-resolved reflectance and photoluminescence spectroscopy. Power-dependent photoluminescence further reveals a pronounced nonlinear response of the confined Jackiw-Rebbi polariton, including a blueshift of up to 5 meV and correlated changes in its intensity scaling and linewidth. These results establish vdW photonic heterostructures as a versatile platform for engineering tunable and nonlinear polaritons localised at topological interfaces.

title: On the gauge-invariant orbital angular momentum of vector optical vortices in the paraxial approximation and beyond
summary: In this paper we present a gauge-invariant formalism for describing the spin and orbital angular momenta of scalar and vector optical vortices. The correction term, arising from consistent incorporation of the transverse vector potential's nonlocality, restores gauge invariance and makes it possible to separate the total angular momentum into spin and orbital components. We propose a method for calculating the orbital and spin angular momenta of multimode vector vortex fields and show that the orbital angular momentum of such beams contains two qualitatively different components. The polarization-independent contribution to the orbital angular momentum is related to the topological charge that determines the order of the phase singularity, while the polarization-dependent one is proportional to the helical topological charge that determines the spatial inhomogeneity of the polarization. We also discuss the quantization procedure for fields with spatially inhomogeneous polarization in terms of modes with a helical topological charge, and examine the limits of applicability of the proposed formalism.
